title: Digital Marketing & Website Specialist
description:
We’re Bespoke Design + Build, a custom design-build company in Coeur d’Alene, Idaho. We’re looking for an experienced digital partner to develop our website, strengthen our social media presence, and manage the systems that turn interest into project inquiries.



Scope of work



Website: Build a refined, fast, mobile-friendly website using our company information and resources from The Professional Builder. Maintain content, galleries, and site performance after launch.



Lead generation: Set up landing pages, inquiry forms,
 capture, free brochure and resource downloads, and automated follow-up.



SEO and online presence: Manage local and technical SEO, Google Business Profile, and consistent business listings.



Phone system: Set up business numbers, call routing, and lead-source tracking.



Analytics: Create a performance dashboard, provide monthly reporting, and recommend improvements. Run A/B tests where appropriate.



Social media strategy: Develop our visual direction, content themes, posting plan, and approach to attracting relevant engagement and inquiries.



Content creation: Edit supplied project photos and footage into polished reels, videos, graphics, and posts. Write captions and manage scheduling and publishing.



How we want pricing structured



We want fixed prices for clearly defined deliverables, with revisions, turnaround times, and any software costs identified upfront.



Please provide separate prices for:



Website design and build, including the proposed pages.



Lead capture, downloads, and
 automation setup.



SEO and business profile setup.



Phone system and call-tracking setup.



Analytics dashboard and conversion-tracking setup.



Social media brand strategy and content plan.



Video editing per finished reel or video, specifying length and included revisions.



Social graphics and captions per post or defined batch.



Ongoing website maintenance, SEO, reporting, and social management as separate fixed monthly packages, with exact quantities and responsibilities.



To apply



Send relevant websites, edited videos, social media examples, and a strategy or reporting sample. Explain your contribution to each, your availability, and your itemized fixed-price proposal.



Tell us which services you perform yourself and whether anyone else would be involved. We value thoughtful design, clear communication, dependable follow-through, and a long-term relationship.

title: Pricing and Promotions Analyst
description:
Company: Cosmo Appliances



POSITION OVERVIEW



The Sales Promotions and Pricing Analyst supports the planning, preparation, and submission of promotional campaigns across multiple sales channels. This role is responsible for ensuring promotions are submitted correctly, tracked, and confirmed before deadlines.



The position requires strong organizational skills, advanced Excel proficiency, and consistent follow-through. The assistant will work closely with management and internal teams to gather required data for promotions and ensure all information is accurate before submission.



This role requires a high level of responsibility and accountability, as promotions must be monitored and followed up on until they are fully confirmed and scheduled.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Promotion Submission & Tracking

• Prepare and submit promotional requests across sales channels and retailer portals.

• Maintain organized records of all promotion submissions, approvals, and campaign details.

• Track promotions from submission through confirmation to ensure they are properly scheduled.

• Follow up with partners or internal teams until promotions are fully confirmed.



Follow-Up & Coordination

• Follow up with management and relevant departments to gather all required data needed for promotion submissions.

• Ensure promotional details such as pricing, product lists, discount structures, and campaign dates are complete before deadlines.

• Monitor upcoming promotional deadlines and proactively communicate missing information.



Data Management & Excel Responsibilities

• Use advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills to perform calculations related to promotional pricing, margins, discounts, and campaign planning.

• Create and maintain spreadsheets used for tracking promotions, pricing adjustments, and campaign performance.

• Review calculations and verify promotional data accuracy before submissions are made.



Accountability & Process Ownership

• Take ownership of assigned promotional campaigns and ensure they are completed accurately and on time.

• Maintain clear tracking of pending submissions and follow up regularly until confirmations are received.

• Communicate status updates to management regarding promotion approvals and outstanding items.



Accuracy & Issue Resolution

• Maintain a high level of attention to detail when preparing promotional submissions and calculations.

• If mistakes occur, take responsibility for identifying the issue and correcting it promptly.

• Work proactively to investigate discrepancies and ensure errors are resolved quickly and properly.

title: Project Cost Engineer / Assistant Project Manager
description:
***** TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME AND A VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING***** 



Project Cost Engineer / Assistant Project Manager



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Time, with a 1-hour break



Job Overview: 

We are seeking a proactive and analytical Project Cost Engineer / Assistant Project Manager with hands-on construction industry experience, preferably in architectural sheet metal, aluminum composite material (ACM) panels, exterior cladding, or building envelope systems. The ideal candidate must have experience using Sage 300 CRE and Procore to monitor project costs, track field productivity, and evaluate financial performance.



This role combines construction cost engineering with project management support, focusing on cost control, labor productivity, cost-to-complete forecasting, and early identification of potential cost overruns. The ideal candidate understands construction operations, can interpret financial and field-production data, and proactively recommends corrective actions to protect project profitability.



Key Responsibilities:

* Monitor project budgets, actual costs, purchase orders, subcontract commitments, and remaining costs for architectural sheet metal, ACM panel, exterior cladding, and building envelope projects.

* Reconcile Sage 300 CRE financial data with Procore daily reports, labor hours, installed quantities, and project progress.

* Analyze labor productivity and compare actual performance against estimated production rates to identify inefficiencies.

* Prepare realistic cost-to-complete forecasts and flag projects trending over budget before substantial losses occur.

* Review field reports for extra work, scope changes, delays, and potential change orders; organize supporting documentation for project manager review.

* Assist with purchase orders, subcontract commitments, cost coding, project documentation, and other assistant project management duties.

* Provide concise morning summaries and weekly reports highlighting budget variances, productivity concerns, outstanding issues, potential change orders, and recommended corrective actions.

* Coordinate with accounting, project managers, and field teams to investigate discrepancies and obtain missing information.

Improve reporting through Excel, automation, and appropriate AI tools, verifying accuracy against source records.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or Industrial Engineering required.

* Relevant experience in construction cost engineering, project controls, or subcontractor cost management.

* Direct experience with architectural sheet metal, ACM panels, exterior cladding, or building envelope construction strongly preferred.

* Hands-on proficiency in Sage 300 CRE, including job costing, purchase orders, commitments, and budget tracking.

* Hands-on proficiency in Procore, including daily reports, labor hours, project progress, documentation, and change orders.

* Strong understanding of construction installation methods, labor productivity, cost forecasting, and change-order documentation.

* Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup formulas, and financial reconciliations.

* Ability to read construction drawings, specifications, estimates, and scope documents; Bluebeam experience preferred.

* Proactive and analytical, with the ability to investigate discrepancies, ask informed questions, and recommend practical solutions independently.

* Strong written and spoken English.

* Availability to work 7:00 AM–4:00 PM Pacific Time.



****Applicants must clearly disclose if they lack experience with Sage 300 CRE or Procore. Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical technical assessment****



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Rental Operations Assistant
description:

Rental Operations Assistant



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday - Friday, 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM Pacific Time, with a 1-hour unpaid break.



Job Overview:

We are seeking a dependable and detail-oriented Rental Operations Assistant to support daily rental operations. In this role, you will process approved rental orders and routine off-rent requests received through a shared
 inbox, enter accurate information into Point of Rental (POR), and maintain organized records. You will work closely with the Inside Sales team to verify order details, prevent duplicate entries, and escalate incomplete or unclear requests.



The ideal candidate has experience in construction equipment rental or administrative order processing, strong attention to detail, and the ability to follow established procedures consistently. This is an administrative processing role, not a sales, dispatch, or management position.



Key Responsibilities:

* Monitor the shared rental orders inbox and track requests using the established status management process.

* Enter complete and approved rental orders into Point of Rental (POR).

* Process routine off-rent and rental termination requests, including customer-provided pickup instructions.

* Verify customer information, equipment details, rental dates and times, delivery locations, jobsite contacts, purchase orders (POs), job numbers, authorized rates, and special instructions against the original request.

* Maintain accurate system entries, record clear notes, and ensure completed requests are traceable to their original
s.

* Organize incoming requests and follow established procedures to prevent duplicate entries.

* Identify missing information, unclear equipment descriptions, conflicting instructions, and other exceptions before processing orders.

* Escalate questions regarding rates, equipment availability, delivery commitments, re-rents, breakdowns, and unusual customer issues to the Corona Inside Sales team.

* Handle straightforward phone orders after training and demonstrated competency, following an approved script and established procedures.

* Follow internal checklists and workflows to ensure accurate, consistent, and timely order processing.

* Support the Corona Inside Sales team by managing routine administrative requests and allowing the local team to focus on * more complex customer and operational matters.



Required Qualifications

* Experience in construction equipment rental, rental order processing, or a related administrative role is highly preferred.

* Familiarity with common construction equipment names, categories, and rental terminology is an advantage.

* Experience using Point of Rental (POR) or similar rental management software is preferred but not required.

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

* Excellent data-entry accuracy and attention to detail.

* Experience managing shared
 inboxes, processing requests, and maintaining organized records.

* Proficiency in business software and digital systems.

* Ability to follow established procedures, checklists, and instructions consistently.

* Good judgment in identifying incomplete or conflicting information and escalating issues appropriately.

* Dependable, coachable, and comfortable handling repetitive administrative tasks.

* Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote-work setup.

* Ability to work the confirmed schedule.



Preferred Qualifications

* Previous experience processing construction equipment rental orders or off-rent requests.

* Familiarity with construction equipment rental workflows and terminology.

* Experience with order-entry systems, inventory or rental management platforms, or customer request processing.

* Experience verifying transaction details and maintaining accurate digital records.

* Experience handling routine customer requests through
 and phone.

* Demonstrated ability to prevent duplicate entries, identify errors, and escalate exceptions rather than make unsupported assumptions.



Working Conditions

* This position does not involve sales, pricing negotiations, discount approvals, or independent credit decisions.

* The employee will not make equipment substitutions, promise equipment availability, or commit to delivery or pickup schedules.

*  Dispatching drivers, coordinating repairs, resolving breakdowns, and selecting re-rent suppliers are outside the scope of this role.

* Incomplete, ambiguous, or conflicting requests must be referred to the Corona Inside Sales team for clarification.

* Rental terminations must not be processed without an identifiable customer and equipment record and clear customer instructions.

title: U.S. Payroll & Construction Accounting Specialist
description:
We are a California-based commercial security, fire alarm, access control, and low-voltage contractor seeking an experienced accounting professional to manage U.S. payroll, California prevailing wage compliance, certified payroll reporting, accounts payable, and construction job costing. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Paychex, QuickBooks Online, California DIR requirements, and construction accounting.



Primary Responsibilities



1. U.S. Payroll Administration

Process employee payroll using Paychex.

Review technician timesheets and reconcile hours with branch managers.

Calculate regular hours, overtime, double-time, and applicable premium pay.

Review payroll adjustments, deductions, and reimbursements.

Prepare payroll summaries for management approval.

Reconcile payroll reports with accounting records.



2. California Prevailing Wage & Certified Payroll

Identify applicable California prevailing wage determinations and classifications.

Understand telecommunications technician and electrical trade classifications.

Calculate prevailing wage rates, fringe benefits, and overtime.

Prepare and submit certified payroll reports through California DIR.

Track apprenticeship training contributions and applicable compliance requirements.

Reconcile certified payroll reports with Paychex records.

Maintain public works payroll documentation for audits and compliance reviews.



3. Accounts Payable

Enter vendor invoices into QuickBooks Online.

Match invoices with purchase orders and delivery receipts.

Assign expenses to the correct jobs and cost categories.

Reconcile vendor statements and credit card transactions.

Prepare weekly payment approval reports.

Identify billing discrepancies and duplicate charges.



4. Construction Job Costing

Track actual labor, materials, equipment, and subcontractor costs by project.

Compare estimated versus actual project costs.

Identify labor overruns and cost discrepancies.

Prepare weekly project profitability reports.

Coordinate with branch managers and the Operations Supervisor to resolve discrepancies.



5. Jobber & Google Workspace

Review job schedules, timesheets, and project records in Jobber.

Maintain payroll reconciliation and job costing spreadsheets.

Organize accounting documentation in Google Drive.

Prepare reports using Google Sheets.

Communicate with management using Gmail and Google Meet.



Required Qualifications

Minimum 3 years of U.S. construction payroll or accounting experience.

Hands-on experience processing payroll using Paychex.

Direct experience with California prevailing wage and DIR certified payroll reporting.

Strong understanding of California overtime and double-time.

QuickBooks Online experience.

Construction job costing experience.

Advanced Google Sheets or Excel skills.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Preferred: Jobber experience, telecommunications or electrical contractor accounting, and apprenticeship compliance experience.



To be considered for this position, you must answer all eight questions below when submitting your application.

How many years have you processed U.S. payroll using Paychex? Which Paychex platform have you used?

Have you personally prepared and submitted California DIR certified payroll reports? Explain your experience.



Which California prevailing wage classifications have you worked with? Explain how you calculate overtime for an employee working on a California prevailing wage project.



Have you handled California apprenticeship training contributions and prevailing wage fringe benefits? Explain your responsibilities.



Describe your experience with QuickBooks Online and construction job costing. How do you track actual labor and material costs against estimated project costs?



Have you used Jobber? If yes, explain which features you have worked with.



What is your expected monthly salary in USD, and what hours can you work to overlap with California business hours?



Important: Applications that do not include answers to all eight questions will not be considered.

Please provide specific examples from your previous work. We are looking for candidates with actual hands-on experience, not general knowledge of payroll or bookkeeping.

title: Senior Executive and Operations Assistant (Fluent English) for a Toronto Tutoring Company
description:
ABOUT EXPLORING SCHOLAR

Exploring Scholar is a tutoring company based in Toronto, Ontario. Our weekends are our busiest time, and many of our families speak English or Mandarin. We are looking for an experienced, resourceful senior assistant to work directly with the owner and act as the central point of coordination across our teachers, staff, and operations.



THE ROLE

This is not a standard admin or call-center job. You will work side by side with the owner, take the growing to-do list off their plate, and make sure things actually get done. You will coordinate between teams, follow up on open items, and keep everything moving. You will not be the main person answering every parent call or booking every class, but you will be the person who keeps it all connected.



This is a senior role. Over time you will take full ownership of key parts of the company's operations that the owner currently runs personally, and you will be accountable for the results. We are looking for someone who has done this before and wants real responsibility, not someone who waits to be told what to do.



You do not need to speak Mandarin. Some of our clients and staff do, so you will use AI tools to translate and draft messages when needed, and you will be expected to do this quickly and carefully.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Act as the central coordination point between the owner, teachers, and staff

- Take ownership of key operational areas, run them end to end, and report results to the owner, with the scope growing as you prove yourself

- Turn the owner's instructions into a clear, prioritized to-do list, then work through it one task at a time

- Execute on tasks quickly and correctly, with minimal follow-up needed

- Write clear SOPs (standard operating procedures) from the instructions and examples the owner gives you

- Support teacher recruitment and onboarding

- Use AI tools to translate and write messages for Mandarin-speaking families and staff, check them for accuracy and tone, and flag anything sensitive or unclear before sending

- Step in on phone, WeChat, and scheduling tasks when the owner needs support

- Keep shared documents, trackers, and records organized in Google Workspace



MUST HAVES

- Fluent spoken and written English at a native or near-native level. This is essential, and you will be assessed on it, including on the phone.

- Very proficient with AI tools in your everyday work, including for translation, writing, and research. You must be able to tell us your skill level and give real examples.

- Resourceful. You work out how to get things done without being told how, and small obstacles do not stop you. You try more than one approach before asking for help, and when you do ask, you bring a proposed solution.

- At least 5 years of experience in executive assistant, operations, or operations management roles, with a track record of independently owning and running key processes or functions without close supervision

- Fast learner who picks up new tools and processes quickly

- Able to juggle many tasks at once and coordinate multiple people without dropping details

- Strong written communication, and able to document processes clearly

- Comfortable with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Calendar, Drive)

- Comfortable on the phone and willing to learn WeChat

- Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, a computer, and a headset, with a backup plan for power or internet outages

- Available during the coverage hours listed below



NICE TO HAVES

- Experience working overnight shifts and weekend shifts

- Any Mandarin ability (a bonus, not a requirement)

- Experience in education, tutoring, or a service business

- Experience with bilingual or Chinese-language customer support

- Experience building SOPs or training materials



SCHEDULE

- Full-time engagement, about 8 billable hours per day

- 12:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. Toronto time (hours follow Toronto's clock, including daylight saving changes), with a one-hour unpaid break

- Flexible off days during weekdays. Weekends Eastern Time are busy and are mandatory work days.

- This is an overnight shift in the Philippines, so please only apply if this works for you long term



TOOLS YOU WILL USE

Our phone system, WeChat, our custom scheduling software, and Google Workspace. We will train you on everything except Google Workspace, which you should already know.



COMPENSATION

- Monthly rate of CAD $2,000 to $2,500 (CANADIAN dollars, not US dollars)

- Where you land in this range depends on how much ownership you have taken in past roles and how much you can contribute without intervention or supervision. The more independently you can run key parts of operations, the higher the pay.

- Paid monthly through Wise, at the beginning of the following month for the full previous calendar month

- A 13th month payment after one full year of working together



ENGAGEMENT TYPE

This is an independent contractor engagement under a written service agreement. You are responsible for your own taxes and registrations, you provide your own computer, headset, and internet, and you send a simple invoice each month.



You will have access to student and family information, so confidentiality and careful handling of that data are required and covered in the agreement.



HOW TO APPLY

To be considered, please send all of the following. Applications without these will not be reviewed.



1. Your resume, showing your years of experience and the responsibilities you owned, and a short note on why you fit this role

2. A Loom video (or any video hosting link) in which you: introduce yourself in English; describe your comfort level with AI tools (beginner, intermediate, or advanced), the tools you use, and one specific time AI dramatically increased your efficiency at work; describe the biggest area of responsibility you have owned independently in a past role and the results you delivered, plus a time you hit a roadblock and worked it out on your own; and confirm you can work 12:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. Toronto time, including weekends.

3. Your expected monthly rate in Canadian or US dollars



Start your application with the word "Scholar" so we know you read the whole post.



HIRING PROCESS



1. Stage 1, application review: applications missing the keyword or the video are not reviewed.

2. Stage 2, practical 10-minute task

3. Stage 3, live interview: the top candidates have a video interview in English

title: Product Sourcing Virtual Assistant (VA)
description:
About Us: We are a growing Amazon business focused on scaling through consistent, profitable product sourcing.



Responsibilities:

• Research and identify profitable product leads using tools like Keepa and SellerAmp

• Follow sourcing criteria (ROI, sales velocity, brand restrictions)

• Submit daily lead lists on time with quality standards

• Update spreadsheets with product and storefront data

• Support ungating efforts by finding auto-ungated or easy-to-ungate products

• Communicate clearly and ask questions when unsure



Requirements:

• Experience with Amazon product sourcing preferred 2-3 months

• Ability to follow detailed Standard Operating Procedures and sourcing guidelines

• Reliable internet and communication skills

• Willingness to learn and improve with feedback

• Work 8 hours per day, 40 hours per week (Monday to Friday)



Compensation:

• $3-4 per hour starting rate

• Weekly base pay around $120-$160 pending on rate

• Bonus plan based on monthly approved lead spend, for example:

• $0-$10,000 spend = $0 bonus

• $10,001-$20,000 spend = $50 bonus

• $20,001-$30,000 spend = $125 bonus

• $30,001-$40,000 spend = $200 bonus

• $40,001-$50,000 spend = $300 bonus

• Over $60,000 spend = $400 bonus

Additional Info:

• Trial period (1-2 weeks) to assess fit and skills

• Training and feedback provided regularly

• Opportunity for growth



Career Path: 

We start all Product Sourcing VAs at a competitive rate of $3-4 per hour. As you demonstrate consistent quality, reliability, and growth in your sourcing skills, there are regular opportunities for raises. Top performers may be promoted to higher roles such as Senior Sourcer or Reviewer/Buyer VA, with increased responsibilities and pay. We value dedication and results, and we want to help you grow your career with us over time.



Application Instructions:

Please include the number "2026" in the subject line of your application
.



In your application, please also mention which product sourcing strategies you know and have experience with (e.g., storefront stalking, best deals, Keepa product finder, yo-yo leads, etc.). This helps us understand your background and fit for the position.



Important Notice: Your sourcing progress and lead submissions will be tracked through SellerAmp. Sharing or distributing leads/products with other Amazon sellers or unauthorized parties is strictly prohibited. If you are caught sharing leads, you will be reported to onlinejobs.ph and disqualified from applying for any future positions with us.

title: Performance Creative Strategist & Producer
description:
Performance Creative Strategist & Producer



DTC Fashion & Jewelry | Meta / TikTok | Remote | Freelance



About Us



We're launching two e-commerce brands:



Above: Curated men's fashion with a minimalist, elevated aesthetic.



KAEN: Modern women's jewelry focused on design and accessible luxury.



We're looking for someone to build and own our advertising creative production system from the ground up.



Your Mission



Develop a repeatable system that consistently produces high-quality, performance-driven ad creatives.



You own the process from research → concept → production → testing → iteration.



You'll work directly with the founder and collaborate with our media buyer.



Responsibilities



Research: Study competitor ads, consumer behavior, and winning creative concepts using Meta Ad Library, TikTok, and other sources.



Strategy: Develop advertising angles, concepts, and creative briefs for both brands.



Production: Source and manage creators, models, editors, and videographers, including cost-effective China-based talent.



Execution: Coordinate production of static and video ads using original footage, existing assets, and AI tools where appropriate.



Optimization: Work with the media buyer to analyze performance, identify winning creatives, and develop improved variations.



Ownership: Manage production timelines, budgets, deliverables, and reporting without requiring constant founder supervision.



Creative Direction



We value strong aesthetics without sacrificing performance.



Above: Fit, styling, movement, fabric, and silhouettes.



KAEN: Jewelry details, close-ups, styling, and elegant product demonstrations.



No generic talking heads, aggressive sales tactics, or excessive discount messaging.



First 30 Days



Build a creative research library and testing strategy.



Develop 20–30 creative concepts.



Establish a network of affordable production partners.



Deliver 10–15 finished, test-ready advertisements.



Implement a weekly production and performance review process.



Requirements



Proven experience producing performance creatives for DTC brands.



Strong understanding of Meta advertising and creative testing.



Experience managing external creators and production teams.



Excellent visual judgment, organization, and independent execution.



Fashion, jewelry, or lifestyle experience preferred.



AI creative tools experience is a plus.



Compensation



Freelance / part-time initially, with potential for a long-term role. Hourly or project-based compensation. Production budgets are separate.



To Apply



Please provide:



Three paid ads you've personally developed, including your exact role and performance results.



How you'd produce 15–20 creatives per month cost-effectively.



Your experience sourcing and managing creators, videographers, and editors.



How you'd approach creative strategy differently for Above versus KAEN.



Your hourly/monthly rate and availability.



We're looking for an operator, not just an ideas person. Someone who can independently build a system, consistently deliver creatives, and improve results through testing.

K-I Machine is a CNC machine shop in Illinois, USA, making precision parts, including for the medical industry. We’re moving from year-end bookkeeping to clean monthly books, and we need a reliable bookkeeper to own that long-term.



What you’ll do



Catch up our 2026 books: enter and categorize January–October in QuickBooks Online from our bank and credit card records, and reconcile every month. Target: complete by mid-January.

Ongoing monthly bookkeeping: enter vendor bills, categorize transactions, create customer invoices, follow up on unpaid invoices, reconcile accounts and prepare month-end reports.

Year-end support: collect W-9s and prepare the 1099 list for our CPA.

Connect our in-house software to QuickBooks: d
 how our jobs, invoices and bills should flow into QuickBooks, write clear change requests (our AI tool does the coding), and test everything in a QuickBooks sandbox.



You’ll work with our in-house accountant, who approves and pays, and our CPA, who handles taxes and quarterly reviews. You will have your own QuickBooks login. You won’t have payment authority.



Requirements



2+ years of QuickBooks Online bookkeeping for US businesses

Experience with catch-up or cleanup projects

QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification preferred

Big plus: manufacturing, inventory or job costing experience, especially with Katana, MRPeasy, Fishbowl or JobBOSS

Strong written English and close attention to detail

Your own computer, reliable internet and backup power



Schedule and pay



Part-time: about [15–20] hrs/week through January, then about [10] hrs/week

Flexible hours, with [2] hours of overlap with US Central business hours

[$8-10/hr] based on experience, paid twice a month via Wise or Payoneer

Start within 1–2 weeks. Long-term role.



How to apply

Start your application with the words “Clean Books” so we know you read this. Then answer:



How many QuickBooks catch-up projects have you done? How many months did the largest one cover?

A machine shop buys aluminum for a customer job, sends the parts out for anodizing, then invoices the customer. How would you record each step in QuickBooks?

What manufacturing or inventory software have you used alongside QuickBooks?

When can you start, and what hours (Philippine time) can you work?



Hiring process: short video call → 30-day trial

title: SOCIAL MEDIA ASSISTANT (SLIMEATORY)
description:
Job Title: Social Media Assistant (Content Calendar & Publishing)

Company: Slimeatory

Location: Remote





About Slimeatory:

Welcome to Slimeatory! We are a colorful, fast-paced brand dedicated to bringing the best slime products, and entertaining content to our massive online community. With millions of views and a highly engaged audience, our social media presence is the heartbeat of our brand. We are looking for an ultra-organized Social Media Assistant to take the wheel on our publishing schedule and keep our feeds looking flawless.





Job Summary:

Are you the type of person who loves a perfectly color-coded calendar? Do you know the best times to post on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts? We are looking for a Social Media Assistant whose primary mission is to manage our content calendar and execute our daily posting strategy. You won't necessarily be the one in front of the camera; instead, you will be the organizational powerhouse behind the scenes, ensuring every piece of content goes live exactly when it should, with the perfect caption, hashtags, and tags.





Key Responsibilities:

- Content Calendar Ownership: Build, maintain, and meticulously update the Slimeatory social media content calendar. Ensure a consistent and strategic pipeline of posts across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and
.

- Daily Scheduling & Publishing: Execute the daily posting of all social media content. Use native platforms and scheduling tools to queue up posts in advance.

- Caption & Copywriting: Write fun, engaging, and brand-appropriate captions for every post. Research and apply relevant hashtags, keywords, and sound trends to maximize reach.

- Asset Organization: Receive raw videos and photos from our content creation team and organize them into neat, accessible folders for future posting.

- Quality Control: Double-check every post before it goes live to ensure correct tags (products, locations, collaborators), working links, and typo-free copy.

- Engagement Monitoring: Spend time immediately after posting to reply to early comments, pin top comments, and engage with our community to boost algorithmic performance.





Qualifications:

- Proven experience managing social media accounts, specifically handling content calendars and publishing schedules.

-  Deep understanding of platform-specific features and posting best practices for TikTok, Instagram (Grid, Reels, Stories), and YouTube Shorts.

- Experience with social media management and scheduling tools.

- Strong copywriting skills.

- A passion for digital media and trends.

title: Quality Assurance Specialist – (Remote PH)
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MedPro Disposal is the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company, serving 35,000+ healthcare providers across 48 states for the past 15 years. On that foundation, we launched MP1 Solutions to pioneer the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined healthcare compliance for decades. MP1 Solutions extends MedPro Disposal's operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading — with a technology-forward approach that's making this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that, backed by 15 years of MedPro Disposal's operational credibility — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

MedPro is growing, and every new client, service agreement and hire adds more work that has to be done right the first time. The Quality Assurance Specialist is the check on that work. You will audit core operational output, find where errors start, and drive fixes so mistakes stop reaching clients. Success means a high, steady accuracy rate across Salesforce records, service agreements and client communication, with repeat errors falling every quarter.

Please note: this is an operations and process audit role, not a software testing role.



Key Responsibilities:

Auditing & Quality Monitoring

• Audit core operational work every week using standard QA scorecards, including Salesforce record accuracy, service agreement requests and client-facing
s

• Build and maintain QA scorecards and audit criteria for each core process, aligned with the steps in MedPro's SOPs

• Track accuracy and error rates by process and by team member, and keep the QA log current and audit-ready



Feedback & Root-Cause Analysis

• Deliver clear, documented QA feedback to team members and their managers within the agreed turnaround

• Analyze error trends to find root causes: SOP gaps, system issues or individual performance

• Flag SOPs that are outdated or unclear, and work with process owners to get them corrected



Reporting & Continuous Improvement

• Report monthly QA results and trends to leadership, with recommended fixes

• Verify that corrective actions worked by re-auditing the affected processes and confirming the error rates dropped



Required Qualifications:

• 2+ years of experience in quality assurance, auditing or operations in a process-heavy role

• Industry background in B2B services, healthcare, logistics or another compliance-driven field

• Bachelor's degree preferred; an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience will be considered

• Strong attention to detail and excellent written English

• Able to work U.S. business hours (CST) for 40 hours per week



Technical Skills:

• Salesforce CRM: navigating records and running reports

• Microsoft 365: Excel for tracking and analysis, SharePoint and Teams

• Asana or a similar task management tool



Nice-to-Have:

• Background in medical waste, environmental services, or OSHA/HIPAA compliance

• Experience building QA scorecards or an audit program from scratch

• Lean or Six Sigma training (Yellow or Green Belt)

• Strong Excel skills: pivot tables and charts for trend analysis

• Root-cause analysis experience, with an example of a fix that lowered an error rate



Compensation & Benefits:

• Salary Range: $700–$900 base salary per month, commensurate with experience and qualifications

• Permanent work-from-home

• 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM CST (graveyard shift)

• Fixed weekends off (Saturday & Sunday)

• Work Anniversary Bonus

• No work with pay on US Holidays



Basic Technical Requirements:

• A consistent and stable internet connection of at least 20Mbps

• With back-up computer, internet connection and power supply

title: SharePoint Developer
description:
About Our Company



Nationwide Sports Construction is a growing U.S.-based sports construction company specializing in synthetic turf athletic fields, sports complexes, and civil construction projects throughout the United States.



We are looking for an experienced Microsoft 365 SharePoint Developer & AI Automation Specialist to help us modernize how our company stores, organizes, secures, and utilizes information.



This is not simply a data entry or file migration position. We need someone who can design, build, and maintain a scalable cloud-based document management system that will support our company as we continue to grow.



Our goal is to transition from traditional server-based file storage to a centralized Microsoft 365 SharePoint environment, while incorporating artificial intelligence to make our company information more accessible and useful.  We have tried, but as we've grown in the past two years, seems like our separate departments are doing their own thing in SharePoint, isolated from each other.



Primary Responsibilities



1. SharePoint Architecture & Development



Design and implement a company-wide Microsoft SharePoint Online environment.

Create organized SharePoint sites, document libraries, folders, and workflows for our various departments.

Establish a clean, logical, scalable document management structure.

Work directly with our department leaders to understand their file storage needs and business processes.

Develop consistent file naming conventions, document organization standards, and metadata structures.

Ensure SharePoint integrates effectively with Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, Outlook, and other Microsoft 365 applications.



Our departments include:

Executive Leadership

Accounting & Finance

Preconstruction & Estimating

Operations & Project Management

Sales & Business Development

Marketing

Equipment & Fleet Management



2. Data Migration & Organization



We currently have years of historical company information stored on our internal server.



Responsibilities include:

Assist with migrating historical files and documents from our existing server into SharePoint Online.

Evaluate and organize existing data before migration.

Identify duplicate, outdated, or unnecessary files.

Develop a logical organizational structure for historical and active construction projects.

Ensure documents remain searchable, accessible, and properly categorized.

Preserve historical project information for future reference.



3. Security & Permission Management

Data security is extremely important to our company.



The successful candidate will:

Establish department-specific access permissions.

Restrict confidential accountin, and Executive information to authorized employees.

Configure SharePoint security groups and role-based permissions.

Ensure employees can access the information they need without accessing confidential information from other departments.

Implement secure document-sharing practices.

Follow Microsoft 365 security best practices.



4. AI Integration – Claude & Document Automation



One of our most important long-term goals is integrating artificial intelligence into our company knowledge base.

We want employees to be able to use Claude AI (Anthropic) to search our historical company information, retrieve relevant documents, and automatically generate new content.



Example Use Case:



Our Marketing Manager receives a request to prepare a proposal for a potential project involving the construction of three synthetic turf soccer fields in Kentucky.



Ideally, she could ask Claude:

"Create a proposal for this Kentucky soccer field project using our company proposal template. Include relevant photographs, descriptions, and examples of similar synthetic turf soccer field projects we have completed in Kentucky or nearby states."



The AI system would then:

Search our historical SharePoint project files.

Identify relevant completed projects.

Retrieve approved project photographs and descriptions.

Populate our standardized company proposal template.

Generate an editable Microsoft Word document for our Marketing Manager to review and finalize.



We understand this functionality may require additional development, API integrations, Microsoft Power Automate, or other AI tools.



We are looking for someone who understands how to build this type of solution or has the technical ability to research, develop, and implement it.



Additional potential AI applications include:



Searching historical construction project documents.

Finding past proposals, estimates, and project information.

Generating marketing materials from existing company content.

Retrieving project photographs and completed project references.

Automating repetitive document creation.



Helping department leaders find information quickly without manually searching through hundreds of folders.



Important: AI access must respect our established SharePoint security permissions. Employees should never be able to retrieve confidential information they are not authorized to access.





Required Qualifications



Strong experience with Microsoft SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365.

Proven experience designing and implementing SharePoint document management systems.

Experience with SharePoint permissions, security groups, and access controls.

Experience migrating files from traditional servers to SharePoint.

Strong knowledge of Microsoft Power Automate.

Understanding of Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and Microsoft 365 integrations.

Ability to develop scalable document organization systems.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Ability to work independently and collaborate with U.S.-based department leaders.

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience integrating Claude AI, Anthropic APIs, or other LLM platforms with business systems.

Knowledge of AI-powered document search and retrieval (RAG).

Experience automating Microsoft Word templates and proposal generation.

Experience with construction companies, project management, or professional services organizations.

Experience building document management systems for growing businesses.



What Success Looks Like



We want to hire someone who can take ownership of this initiative and help us accomplish the following:



Phase 1 – Planning & Architecture

Meet with company leadership, understand our existing file structure, and design a comprehensive SharePoint environment.



Phase 2 – SharePoint Implementation

Build our company SharePoint sites, establish department permissions, and implement a scalable document management structure.



Phase 3 – Data Migration

Organize and migrate our historical server files into SharePoint while maintaining security and accessibility.



Phase 4 – AI Integration

Develop a secure connection between SharePoint and Claude AI (or another approved AI solution) to allow employees to search company information and automate document generation.



Phase 5 – Training & Optimization

Train employees, document procedures, and continue improving our systems and workflows.



How to Apply



Please include the following information with your application:

Include the sentence "Sports Construction is fun!"

Describe your experience building SharePoint Online environments for businesses.

Have you migrated files from an on-premises server to SharePoint? Please explain.

Have you implemented department-specific security permissions in SharePoint?

Have you integrated Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or another AI platform with SharePoint or Microsoft 365?

Describe a document automation or AI integration project you have completed.

What would your recommended approach be for building the system described in this job posting?

Please provide examples of relevant projects or a portfolio of your previous work.

We are looking for a technically skilled, detail-oriented professional who can help build a long-term technology foundation for our growing company.

title: Personal Creative & Wellness Assistant: For Someone Who Already Lives These Interests (Remote, Long-Term)
description:
This is not a typical VA job. Please read every word. The application is designed so the right person will enjoy it and everyone else will find it too much trouble.



I'm a mature, established CEO. My business is fully staffed, and this role has nothing to do with it. This is about my personal life: my writing, travel, and personal growth. I'm looking for one emotionally grounded, dependable person to support that over the long term.



What You'll Help With



• Writing: Brainstorming, researching, and editing my published romance articles, with honest feedback.



• Travel and hiking: Researching destinations and trails, planning itineraries, and handling bookings.



• Meditation and yoga: Finding and comparing retreats, including ones rooted in Eastern contemplative and tantric philosophy traditions.



• Personal growth: Supporting my self-help book clubs with reading lists, discussion questions, and scheduling.



I don't expect you to love all of these. No one genuinely does. I'd much rather hear about the one or two that are truly part of your life than hear that you're passionate about everything.



Who You Are



• Emotionally mature, calm, and honest



• Loyal and reliable: you follow through without reminders



• Discreet and trustworthy with personal matters



• A strong English writer who is comfortable discussing romance and relationships professionally



• Any age; life experience is welcome



Terms



Remote, about 10 hours/week, long-term, starting with a paid 30-day trial. Compensation is fair and will be discussed personally with candidates I invite to interview. Since alignment comes first for me, I'd ask that you focus your application on who you are rather than on rates.



Please don't send a resume. Your work history matters less to me than who you are. Send the items below instead.



How to Apply



1. Subject line: "Aligned: [your first name] - [the ONE interest closest to your heart]"



2. Pick one or two interests and tell me how each shows up in your life right now. Give me real details: which trail, which book, how long you've practiced, what you write about. I'll recognize general statements.



3. Tell me which interest on my list you connect with LEAST, and why. Honesty here counts in your favor.



4. Name a book that changed you and describe one specific moment when it made a difference in your life.



5. Writing sample: Send
words of something personal and unpolished: a journal entry, a memory, or a reflection. I value your own voice far more than perfect grammar. Please don't send anything written for clients or employers.



6. A 2-minute voice recording introducing yourself and talking about the interest you named in your subject line. Just speak naturally; no script needed.



7. One question you'd ask me about my writing, travel, or practice. Please leave out questions about pay, hours, or benefits. We'll cover those together in the interview.



Please write in your own words. I can tell when answers were written with AI or repeat the wording of this post, and those applications won't be considered.



I look forward to hearing from the right person.

title: QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper – Real Estate Investment Company
description:
I am seeking an experienced, dependable Virtual Assistant to handle bookkeeping for a small real estate investment company. Applicants must have at least 2 years of hands-on professional experience with QuickBooks Online.

This is an ongoing, part-time gig position. During the initial phase, you should expect approximately 2 hours of work per day as we organize and clean up the existing books. Once everything is up to date and properly organized, the workload is expected to decrease to approximately 1 hour per day.



I am looking for someone who is trustworthy, organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking responsibility for maintaining accurate financial records.



Job Responsibilities

1. QuickBooks Online Bookkeeping

     Maintain the company's financial records in QuickBooks Online.

     Properly categorize income, expenses, and other transactions.

     Reconcile bank accounts and credit card statements.

     Review transactions for accuracy and correct classification.

     Find and correct duplicate, uncategorized, or incorrectly classified transactions.

     Maintain organized bookkeeping records for a small real estate portfolio.

    Assist with monthly financial reviews and reporting.



2. QuickBooks Cleanup and Organization 

Our existing QuickBooks company file has accumulated several inactive, dormant, and potentially unnecessary accounts. One of your first priorities will be to review and improve the current bookkeeping setup.

This will include:

     Reviewing the existing Chart of Accounts.

     Identifying duplicate, inactive, dormant, or unnecessary accounts.

     Recommending which accounts should be retained, consolidated, or deactivated.

     Reviewing and correcting transaction classifications when appropriate.

     Improving the overall organization of the books.

     Establishing a clean, manageable bookkeeping system going forward.

     Important: You must be comfortable inheriting an existing QuickBooks file that needs attention, organization, and cleanup.



3. Communication and Accountability

     Send a brief daily activity report summarizing completed work, hours worked, and any outstanding issues.

     Attend a scheduled one-hour weekly meeting with the owner to discuss progress, questions, and priorities.

     Communicate promptly when clarification or approval is needed.

     Bring unusual transactions, discrepancies, and potential problems to the owner's attention rather than guessing or making     unauthorized changes.



Hours and Compensation

    Hourly Rate: $6 USD.

    Initial Workload: Approximately 2 hours per day.

   Ongoing Workload: Approximately 1 hour per day after the initial cleanup.

   Weekly Meeting: One hour with the owner.

   Position Type: Ongoing, part-time gig work.

   Growth Potential: Opportunity for continued work for someone who performs well. 



Actual hours may fluctuate depending on the amount of bookkeeping work and the progress of the initial cleanup.

    Time Tracking and Payment

    Payments will be made through Sendwave.

   You will be required to use a time-tracking application to record all working hours.

   Accurate time tracking is mandatory.

   A daily activity report must accompany your work.



Required Qualifications

   Applicants must meet the following requirements:

   Minimum of 2 years of professional QuickBooks Online experience.

   Previous real estate bookkeeping experience is preferred.

   Strong understanding of basic bookkeeping and accounting principles.

   Experience reconciling bank and credit card accounts.

   Experience categorizing financial transactions.

   Ability to review and organize an existing QuickBooks company file.

   Excellent attention to detail and organizational abilities.

   Good written and spoken English.

   Reliable internet connection and a suitable computer.

   Ability to participate in a weekly one-hour meeting with the owner.

   Ability to work independently, meet expectations, and provide consistent daily updates.



How to Apply

To be considered, please include ALL of the following in your application:

   1. QuickBooks Online Experience

      Explain your bookkeeping background and specify exactly how many years you have worked professionally with                                 QuickBooks Online.

2. Relevant Bookkeeping Skills

Describe your experience with:

    Bank and credit card reconciliations.

   Categorizing income and expenses.

   Reviewing and correcting transaction classifications.

   Cleaning up and organizing an existing QuickBooks company file.

3. Resume

   Provide a link to your current resume (Google Drive or another accessible link).

4. Additional Experience

   Include any previous property management or residential leasing experience. Bonus points if you have worked with a real    estate investment company.

5. Availability

   Confirm that you can initially commit to approximately 2 hours per day and attend a weekly one-hour meeting with the owner.

6. Equipment and Internet

   Confirm that you have a reliable internet connection and a computer suitable for professional bookkeeping work.

7. Favorite Filipino Celebrity

Use 4 Application Points when submitting your application.

title: Remote Guest Relations & Operations Coordinator (Airbnb / Short-Term Rentals)
description:
Company: RDM Capital Management LLC

Location: Remote (Philippines)

Schedule: Opening Shift (10:00 PM – 7:00 AM Philippine Time / 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Dallas Time)

Work Days: 5 days per week (rotating schedule with monthly adjustments)



---



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced and dependable Guest Relations & Operations Coordinator to join our growing Short-Term Rental team.



This is not a typical administrative Virtual Assistant role. You will handle real-time guest support, coordinate cleanings, manage operational issues, and ensure guests receive timely assistance throughout their stay.



We currently manage 60+ Airbnb units across multiple buildings in Dallas, Texas, and continue to grow.



If you're looking for a slow-paced or low-volume VA position, this role is not the right fit.



---



Primary Responsibilities



Guest Relations



- Respond promptly to Airbnb guest inquiries and messages

- Handle guest concerns professionally and efficiently

- Escalate complex situations when necessary

- Deliver excellent guest experiences while maintaining company policies

- Guide arriving guests through the check-in process across multiple buildings and units

- Provide clear instructions and support to ensure smooth and successful guest arrivals



Cleaning Coordination



- Coordinate daily turnovers with housekeeping

- Monitor cleaning progress and unit readiness

- Communicate schedule changes and extensions

- Ensure same-day check-ins remain on schedule



Outbound Guest Calls



- Contact guests before check-out

- Remind guests of their scheduled check-out time

- Assist with operational follow-ups when required



Maintenance Coordination



- Log maintenance work orders

- Coordinate with maintenance vendors

- Track ongoing maintenance requests until completion



---



Required Experience



- Minimum 1 year of internal Airbnb customer support experience. Resolutions 2 or higher (non-negotiable)

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills

- Strong spoken English with a natural, confident, and conversational communication style

- Comfortable speaking directly with guests without relying heavily on scripted or overly formal call-center-style communication

- Comfortable making outbound calls to guests

- Excellent multitasking and organizational skills

- Strong attention to detail

- Ability to remain calm under pressure

- Willingness to learn and confidently guide guests through check-in procedures across multiple properties

- Strong coachability and professional maturity (able to receive constructive feedback, apply it, and continuously improve)

- Comfortable working in a performance-driven environment where feedback and process adjustments are part of day-to-day operations



Availability



- Must be willing to consistently work the graveyard shift (10:00 PM – 7:00 AM Philippine Time)

- Must be fully available during scheduled working hours

- This is a real-time operations role where responsiveness is essential



---



What to Expect



This role operates in a fast-paced environment.



You will often manage multiple guest conversations, cleaning coordination, maintenance requests, and operational updates at the same time.



As our portfolio continues to expand, maintaining consistency, responsiveness, and attention to detail becomes increasingly important.



We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, communicates well under pressure, takes ownership of their responsibilities, and views constructive feedback as an opportunity to improve.



Guest communication should feel natural and human. We want someone who can speak confidently with guests, adapt their tone to the situation, and communicate clearly without sounding overly scripted.



Feedback is a normal part of our day-to-day operations. We value team members who can receive coaching professionally, make adjustments when needed, and continue developing as the business grows.



---



How to Apply



To confirm you've read the entire job posting, start your cover letter with "RDM" and briefly confirm that you understand the schedule, responsibilities, and expectations of this role, including guiding guests through the check-in process.



Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be considered.
