The Project Coordinator, Rent Ready is a central part of SJA Pros' daily operations, responsible for ensuring maintenance requests and projects move efficiently from initial assignment through completion, documentation, and billing.

This role serves as a primary point of coordination between SJA Pros, subcontractors, residents, and the Maintenance Services Team (MST). The Project Coordinator is responsible for maintaining visibility across active work orders, coordinating schedules, developing accurate scopes and estimates, and ensuring work progresses without unnecessary delays.

Success in this role requires exceptional organization, attention to detail, proactive communication, and a strong sense of ownership. The ideal candidate can balance a high volume of daily service requests while maintaining the accuracy, professionalism, and follow-through necessary to deliver an excellent customer experience.



Key Responsibilities



1. Work Order Intake & Assignment



Receive and review maintenance work orders submitted by MST.

Evaluate work order details, inspection reports, photographs, and supporting documentation to understand the requested work.

Identify the appropriate trade, urgency, and subcontractor requirements.

Assign work to qualified subcontractors based on availability, capabilities, pricing, and project needs.

Provide subcontractors with complete work instructions, supporting documentation, and clear expectations.

Identify incomplete information or potential scope concerns and seek clarification before dispatching work.

Review move-out inspection reports and identify maintenance, repair, cleaning, replacement, and improvement requirements for upcoming unit turns.

Coordinate the assignment of individual scopes to multiple subcontractors based on trade specialization, bid results, availability, and project requirements.



2. Scheduling & Service Coordination



Coordinate scheduling between subcontractors, residents, and internal teams.

Confirm appointment dates, access requirements, and expected service timelines.

Manage rescheduling, cancellations, access difficulties, and other scheduling conflicts.

Maintain accurate, up-to-date scheduling information within company systems.

Anticipate scheduling conflicts and proactively address delays before they affect project completion.

Develop and coordinate unit turn schedules based on property availability, anticipated move-in dates, subcontractor capacity, and project deadlines while ensuring subcontractors meet established scheduling and response-time expectations

Coordinate work sequencing across multiple trades to minimize scheduling conflicts, downtime, and delays in preparing units for occupancy.



3. Work Order Monitoring & Follow-Through

Maintain visibility across active work orders to ensure projects continue progressing toward completion.

Follow up with subcontractors regarding appointment confirmations, progress, outstanding requirements, and expected completion dates.

Identify stalled work orders, recurring delays, and incomplete assignments.

Communicate changes, delays, and service concerns to MST and other appropriate stakeholders.

Escalate complex project issues or operational obstacles when additional support is needed.

Ensure completed work is properly documented and ready for administrative closeout.

Track overall unit turn progress, including approved work, pending items, outstanding repairs, and completion deadlines, to ensure properties remain on track for rent-ready status.



4. Scoping & Estimating



Develop clear, accurate, and actionable scopes of work and estimates for maintenance and construction projects, including:

Unit turns and rent-ready preparations.

Multi-trade repairs and construction projects.

Capital improvements and renovation work.

Projects requiring detailed or insurance-aligned documentation.

Responsibilities include:

Reviewing inspection reports, contractor recommendations, photographs, and property condition documentation.

Translating findings into detailed scopes that clearly define the work to be performed.

Identifying labor, materials, subcontractor requirements, and appropriate work sequencing.

Preparing estimates using established pricing standards and cost considerations.

Developing organized bid packages for subcontractor review and pricing.

Creating professional, customer-facing proposals that explain recommended work, expected outcomes, and relevant considerations.

Identifying opportunities to present alternative solutions that balance cost, property condition, and long-term value.

Prepare and distribute bid requests to qualified subcontractors and evaluate submitted proposals based on pricing, scope accuracy, availability, and subcontractor qualifications.

Compare subcontractor bids and assign individual scopes of work to the most suitable subcontractor based on overall value and project requirements.

Separate required repairs from optional improvements and coordinate owner approvals before authorizing additional work.

Maintain standardized pricing libraries for recurring maintenance and turn-related services.



5. Quality Control & Project Closeout



Review subcontractor completion documentation to verify work aligns with the assigned scope.

Confirm required photographs, service notes, and completion details have been submitted.

Identify incomplete work, discrepancies, or concerns requiring additional review.

Review subcontractor invoices for consistency with approved scopes, labor, materials, and pricing.

Coordinate corrections or request clarification when documentation or invoices are incomplete.

Ensure work orders are accurately updated and closed upon completion.

Provide accurate job-costing and billing information to support timely invoice processing.

Reconcile completed work against approved estimates and submitted invoices, identifying discrepancies, unapproved charges, and cost variances.

 



6. Communication & Customer Service



Maintain clear, professional, and timely communication with residents, subcontractors, MST, and internal team members.

Provide proactive updates regarding project status, scheduling, delays, and next steps.

Communicate project scopes and recommendations in a way that is easy for customers and internal stakeholders to understand.

Anticipate questions and potential concerns to minimize confusion and unnecessary back-and-forth.

Address service issues with professionalism, accountability, and a solutions-oriented approach.

Help establish confidence and trust through consistent communication, accurate information, and dependable follow-through.



7. Documentation & Systems Management



Maintain organized and accurate records for each work order and project.

Ensure scopes, estimates, contractor documentation, photographs, invoices, and communications are properly recorded.

Keep project statuses, scheduling information, and relevant details current within company systems.

Follow established processes for documentation, project tracking, and administrative closeout.

Support the continued development and standardization of estimating templates, workflows, and project documentation.



Skills & Qualifications



*Exceptional organizational skills and ability to manage multiple active assignments simultaneously.

*Strong written and verbal communication skills.

*High attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate records.

*Experience coordinating contractors, maintenance services, or construction projects preferred.

*Ability to interpret inspection reports, contractor recommendations, and basic construction scopes.

*Familiarity with construction estimating, labor and material pricing, and subcontractor coordination preferred.

*Strong problem-solving skills and ability to identify priorities independently.

*Comfortable learning and working within multiple software platforms.

*Proactive, dependable, customer-focused, and accountable for results.



What Success Looks Like



A successful Project Coordinator ensures that:

*Work moves forward: Requests are assigned promptly, schedules are confirmed, and work orders do not remain unnecessarily stalled.

*Communication builds confidence: Residents, subcontractors, and internal teams understand what is happening and what comes next.

*Scopes are accurate: Contractors have the information necessary to perform the requested work, and customers receive understandable, well-supported proposals.

*Costs remain controlled: Estimates are accurate, subcontractor bids are properly evaluated, approved work is clearly documented, and invoices are reconciled against actual completed work.

*Documentation is complete: Work orders contain the information needed to verify completion, review costs, and support billing.

*Issues are addressed proactively: Potential problems are identified early rather than discovered after deadlines are missed.

*Operations continuously improve: Recurring problems are identified and workflows are refined to improve efficiency, consistency, and service quality.

*Projects stay on schedule: Unit turns are properly planned, subcontractors are coordinated across trades, and required work is completed within established timelines and before upcoming deadlines/move-in dates.

title: Medical Practice & Executive Virtual Assistant | Long-Term Opportunity
description:
Seeking Medical Practice & Executive Virtual Assistant for a Long-Term Opportunity



Company: Heirloom Family Medicine in Albany, New York, USA 

VA Location: Remote 

Schedule: Full Time

Compensation: $6-9 USD/hour, depending on experience and qualifications, with opportunities for increased compensation as responsibilities grow.





ABOUT HEIRLOOM FAMILY MEDICINE

Hi! I'm Dr. Meghan Monthie, a board-certified family physician and founder of Heirloom Family Medicine, a small but growing independent direct primary care medical practice in Albany, New York, USA (about 2.5 hours north of NYC). 



I created Heirloom in September 2025 because I believe healthcare can (and should!) be better. Heirloom is a direct primary care (DPC) membership-based practice that allows me to spend more time with patients, build meaningful relationships, and provide thoughtful, personalized care, particularly to busy moms who are juggling busy professional careers along with caring for their children, aging parents, and partners. 

You can learn more about the practice on our website and Instagram:







As a solo physician and small business owner, I wear a lot of hats! I'm looking for a reliable, organized, proactive virtual assistant who can help me manage the behind the scenes work of running a small, high-touch medical practice and small business.



My hope is to find someone who help me with my day to day administrative tasks within Heirloom and eventually grow into a trusted, long-term right-hand support as the practice expands.





WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

This position combines medical practice administration, executive assistant responsibilities, and general business operations.



Initially, most of your work will be behind the scenes with limited direct patient communication, although direct patient-facing responsibilities may increase as we work together and based on your interest. 



You won't be expected to know how to do everything on day one. We'll start with shadowing my current workflows before discussing clearly defined responsibilities and expanding your role as we build trust and learn how to work together.





1) Medical Practice Administration

- Organizing and tracking imaging/lab results, referrals, medical records requests, and outstanding administrative tasks

- Following up with prospective patients

- Assisting with new patient onboarding, including organizing and tracking required legal documents and requesting, obtaining, and organizing medical records

- Maintaining accurate spreadsheets to track patient recruitment, onboarding, and retention 

- Helping create and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs)

- Supporting practice workflows and identifying opportunities for improvement

- Triaging patient messages that come in via phone, text, and secure messaging

- Escalating urgent patient concerns to Dr. Meghan 

- Preparing charts for patient appointments - i.e. tracking down and attaching relevant records to notes 





2) Executive & Administrative Support

- Organizing and prioritizing e-mails, tasks, and projects

- Helping manage calendars, scheduling, and deadlines

- Tracking action items and ensuring important tasks don't fall through the cracks

- Conducting online research and gathering information to support decisions

- Organizing files, documents, and digital systems

- Assisting with occasional personal administrative tasks that support my ability to complete my clinical duties, as agreed upon

- Essentially keeping me on task and making me look good! :) 





3) Business Operations & Special Projects

- Helping organize and execute ongoing business projects

- Supporting basic marketing and communications tasks

- Researching software, vendors, and potential solutions

- Creating checklists, templates, and repeatable workflows

- Helping improve efficiency as the practice grows

- Assisting with social media (Instagram,
, Google Business Profile) and e-mail marketing using Canva and Flodesk, if desired and time allows





WHO I'M LOOKING FOR

I'm looking for someone who is:

- Exceptionally organized: You enjoy creating order out of chaos and can keep track of multiple moving pieces. You can keep me  and the millions of ideas in my head on task! 

- Proactive: You're a self starter. You notice what needs to be done, anticipate next steps, and take initiative. 

- Resourceful: You're comfortable researching solutions and figuring things out independently. You think through next steps and use available resources to help answer questions before asking for help, but ask for assistance when appropriate or needed. 

- Detail-oriented: You catch mistakes, follow instructions carefully, and understand that small details matter. 

- A strong communicator: You write clearly in English, ask thoughtful questions, and provide updates without needing to be chased down.

- Dependable: You follow through on commitments and take ownership of your work.

- Tech-savvy: You learn new software quickly and enjoy finding ways to make work easier.

- Adaptable: You're comfortable working in a growing small business where priorities and processes may evolve. 

- Trustworthy: You understand the importance of confidentiality, especially in a small healthcare practice setting.

- Positive and aligned in Heirloom's mission: You enjoy helping others and like to have fun while you do it! 





QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong organizational and time-management skills

- Proficiency with (or a willingness to learn how to use) Google Workspace (Gmail, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Calendar)

- Experience with administrative support, virtual assistance, or project coordination

- Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment

- Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities



Preferred, but not required:

- Experience supporting a physician, healthcare practice, or other healthcare professional

- Experience working with protected health information (PHI) in a HIPAA-compliant healthcare environment

- Experience as an executive assistant or operations assistant

- Experience with project management tools, Canva, or workflow automation

- Experience creating SOPs and improving administrative processes



Relevant healthcare experience is a huge plus, although a good fit is more important. I'm equally interested in candidates with excellent executive assistant or operations experience who are motivated to learn.







SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION

This is a full-time position (40 hours/week). 



Some availability during US Eastern Time business hours (Monday through Friday, 8AM to 4PM EST) is important for communication and collaboration, although some of this work may eventually be completed independently and on your own schedule. 



Compensation ranges from $6-9 USD/hour, depending on experience, skills, qualifications, and fit with opportunities for increased compensation as responsibilities grow.





WHY WORK WITH ME AT HEIRLOOM 

Heirloom is a small, mission-driven primary care practice with big aspirations.



You'll work directly with me, the physician and founder, and have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how the practice operates.



I value kindness, integrity, curiosity, thoughtful communication, and people who take ownership of their work.



I'm looking to build a collaborative, respectful working relationship where your ideas and contributions are valued.



For the right person, this is an opportunity to grow into a larger operations and executive support role as Heirloom continues to develop.





HOW TO APPLY

Please complete our application questionnaire:





I'm interested in learning about your experience, how you approach problems, and why this particular opportunity appeals to you.



Please answer thoughtfully and in your own words. I'm looking for someone who is a great fit for this role and our practice, not simply someone who can write a perfect application.





I look forward to hearing from and getting to know you!



Dr. Meghan Monthie

Founder, Heirloom Family Medicine

title: Creator Analyst (Influencer Research)
description:
ABOUT US



Kadia Fulfillment is a fast-growing gifting studio and brand operations company based in Dallas, Texas. We design, assemble, and ship custom PR boxes, influencer gifting campaigns, and retail gift collections for beauty, lifestyle, and fashion brands across the United States. Our clients include brands distributed through Macy's, Bloomingdale's, and sold on Amazon and direct-to-consumer.



We also operate a staffing division that places skilled remote professionals with top-tier influencer marketing platforms and agencies. Our current partner is CreatorIQ — one of the leading enterprise creator marketing platforms in the world.



THE ROLE



We are looking for a detail-oriented Creator Analyst to support influencer campaign operations for our client partner CreatorIQ. This is NOT primarily a sourcing role — while you will occasionally assist with creator identification, the core of this position is campaign execution: setting up campaigns, coordinating creator outreach, managing contracts, tracking performance, and supporting creators throughout the campaign lifecycle.



This is a remote contractor role. You will work with our Kadia Fulfillment team and receive direction from our client's campaign managers to keep influencer campaigns running smoothly from kickoff through final reporting.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



Campaign Setup & Operations

- Set up and configure campaigns within the CreatorIQ platform following established workflows

- Organize campaign briefs, deliverable requirements, and creator lists for each program

- Coordinate logistics between internal teams and creators throughout campaign timelines



Creator Outreach & Relationship Support

- Send templated outreach emails to creators/influencers on behalf of campaign managers

- Track responses, follow up with non-responders, and maintain communication logs

- Serve as a point of contact for creators during active campaigns — answer questions, share briefs, and keep things on track



Contracting & Onboarding

- Assist with sending and tracking creator contracts and agreements

- Collect and verify required creator information for onboarding and payment processing

- Flag missing documents or non-compliant submissions to the campaign manager



Reporting & Data Management

- Pull campaign performance data from CreatorIQ and other reporting tools

- Build and maintain Google Sheets trackers for deliverable status, posting dates, and engagement metrics

- Compile weekly/campaign-end performance summaries for internal review



Creator Identification (Supporting Role)

- Occasionally assist with vetting creator lists against campaign criteria (niche, follower count, engagement, platform)

- Research creator profiles on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube as needed



REQUIREMENTS — MUST HAVE

- Google Sheets / Excel: Proficient — you will build and maintain trackers, reporting logs, and campaign data sheets daily

- Email Outreach: Ability to manage high-volume templated email outreach professionally and accurately

- Attention to Detail: Campaign data entry, contract tracking, and reporting require a zero-error mindset

- English Communication: Must write and communicate clearly in professional English — emails, reports, and Slack messages

- SaaS Platform Fluency: Comfortable learning and working in new tools quickly (CreatorIQ, Airtable, Google Suite, etc.)

- Availability: Must be available during agreed working hours and responsive within a reasonable time window



NICE TO HAVE

- Prior experience with influencer marketing platforms (CreatorIQ, AspireIQ, Grin, or similar)

- Familiarity with TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube creator ecosystems

- Experience coordinating contracts or agreements in a professional setting

- Background in digital marketing, brand partnerships, or campaign coordination

- Experience using Airtable, Notion, or ClickUp for project tracking



HOW THIS ROLE WORKS

1. Campaign Kickoff — You receive the campaign brief, creator list, and outreach templates from the campaign manager

2. Outreach & Setup — You configure the campaign in the platform, send outreach emails, and track creator responses

3. Contracting — You send contracts, collect creator info, and flag any missing submissions

4. Active Campaign Support — You respond to creator questions, monitor deadlines, and escalate issues to the campaign manager

5. Reporting — You pull performance data, update trackers, and compile the campaign summary report



COMPENSATION

This is a part-time remote contractor role. Compensation is paid weekly or bi-weekly.

- Part-time (20 hrs/week): $400 – $600/month based on experience

- Full-time (40 hrs/week): $800 – $1,200/month for high-performing contractors as campaigns scale

- Performance bonuses available for top performers with consistent delivery

Payment is sent via PayPal or Wise.



HOW TO APPLY

In your application, please include:

- A brief description of your experience with campaign coordination, outreach, or influencer marketing

- Any tools or platforms you've used (Google Sheets, CRMs, influencer platforms, project management tools)

- Your availability (hours per week and time zone)

- Your expected monthly rate in USD



We review applications on a rolling basis. Strong applicants will be contacted for a short skills assessment before a final interview.

title: IT MSP Level 1/2 Technician
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a full-time, experienced technical support professional to support our U.S.-based customers across managed IT, cloud services, business communications, VoIP, and emerging AI technologies.



This is not an entry-level help desk position. We are specifically looking for an experienced technician who already has a strong foundation in computers, Windows, Microsoft 365, networking, troubleshooting, and customer support. Experience with business telecommunications, VoIP, SIP, cloud PBX systems, or related communications technologies is especially valuable.



We are offering compensation at the experienced/expert level because we want someone who knows how to troubleshoot problems, think independently, communicate professionally with customers, and take ownership of issues through resolution.



Our company has nearly 30 years of experience in managed IT and cloud services. MSP support remains an important part of our business, but the next generation of the company is increasingly focused on Cloudspire Voice and Cloudspire AI. The person joining our technical team will work across both sides of the business.



### Must Have (intermediate to advanced)



- Microsoft 365 administration: users, licenses, mailboxes, shared mailboxes, MFA, and Exchange Online basics

- Networking: IP addressing and subnets, DNS, DHCP, routing basics, VPNs, and firewalls

- Diagnosing connectivity and call quality issues such as packet loss, latency, and jitter, and knowing how to test for them

- At least 2 years in a hands-on Level 1/Level 2 support role, ideally at an MSP



### Primary Responsibilities



- Provide Level 1 and Level 2 help desk and technical support

- Troubleshoot Windows desktops, applications, connectivity, printers, email, and general end-user issues

- Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft 365 environments

- Use our RMM platform (NinjaOne) for endpoint monitoring, management, remote access, patching, and support

- Work with our endpoint security platform (SentinelOne), including reviewing alerts and assisting with threat mitigation

- Prior NinjaOne or SentinelOne experience is a plus but not required; we will train you

- Troubleshoot networking issues involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, routers, firewalls, Wi-Fi, and general connectivity

- Work extensively within our ticketing system while following documented procedures, priorities, escalation requirements, and service standards

- Document troubleshooting, changes, customer communications, and resolutions thoroughly and accurately



### VoIP & Cloud Communications



Telecommunications is an increasingly important part of this position. You will support our Cloudspire Voice platform and work with business-class VoIP systems, including:



- VoIP and SIP troubleshooting

- Cloud PBX administration

- Phone provisioning and configuration

- Extensions, users, hunt groups, auto attendants, call queues, and call routing

- Troubleshooting call quality, registration, connectivity, and signaling issues

- Number provisioning and related telecom support

- Supporting physical phones, softphones, and mobile applications

- Working directly with customers to diagnose and resolve communications problems



Strong prior VoIP, SIP, PBX, UCaaS, or telecommunications experience will be highly valued.



### AI & Emerging Technology



Cloudspire AI is one of the fastest-growing areas of our business. Prior AI experience is **not required**, but it is a significant advantage.



The technician will have an opportunity to learn and work with:



- AI voice agents

- AI-powered customer service and communications

- Agent prompting and configuration

- Call flows and automation

- API integrations

- Troubleshooting AI conversations and behaviors

- Connecting AI agents with business systems and communications platforms



We are looking for someone who is interested in learning these technologies rather than someone who wants to remain exclusively in traditional desktop support.



### Customer Service & Communication



Customer satisfaction is extremely important to us.



You will communicate directly with U.S.-based customers by telephone, email, tickets, and remote support sessions throughout the workday. You must be professional, patient, courteous, and confident speaking with customers.



*** Excellent spoken and written English is required. ***



Attention to detail is also critical. Tickets must be documented correctly, instructions must be followed carefully, configurations must be verified, and customer requests must be completed accurately.



### Additional Skills That Can Create Opportunity



We are a small technology company, so people who bring skills beyond their primary role can have opportunities to contribute in other areas.



Experience or interest in any of the following would be considered a significant bonus:



- Technology sales or pre-sales

- Conducting product demonstrations

- Customer relationship management

- Business development

- Lead generation

- Digital marketing

- Social media or LinkedIn outreach

- Helping identify additional services that would benefit an existing customer



These skills are **not requirements for the position**. Technical ability and customer support come first. However, someone who combines strong technical knowledge with communication, business, or sales ability could become especially valuable as the company grows.



### The Person We Are Looking For



We want an experienced technician who can investigate a problem rather than immediately escalate it.



The right person should be comfortable moving between a Windows computer problem, a Microsoft 365 issue, a network problem, a VoIP call-routing issue, and a Cloudspire configuration during the same day.



You should be:



- Technically experienced and naturally curious

- Strong at troubleshooting and problem solving

- Comfortable working independently

- Extremely attentive to detail

- Organized with tickets and documentation

- Dependable and consistent

- Professional with customers

- Interested in VoIP, communications, cloud technology, and AI

- Willing to continue learning as our products and technology evolve



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term position and who can become an important member of our technical team.



### Schedule



This is a full-time, fully remote position supporting U.S.-based customers.



**Monday through Friday**

**8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time**



Reliable attendance and availability during these hours are essential.



### How to Apply (voice recording required)



Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.



Record a 1 to 2 minute voice recording of yourself speaking to a customer as if you were on the phone: their whole office lost phone service 20 minutes ago, they're upset, and their clients are calling them. Explain what you're doing and what happens next.



Upload the recording to Vocaroo (vocaroo.com), Google Drive, or a similar service, make sure anyone with the link can listen, and paste the link at the top of your application message.



In your application message, also include:

- Your monthly pay expectation in USD

- Whether you can reliably work 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern, Monday to Friday

• Respond to and follow up with inbound property inquiries

• Ask questions to understand each customer’s needs, budget, preferred area, and timeline

• Suggest suitable properties using information and materials approved by our team

• Coordinate property viewing requests with customers and our Japan-based team

• Follow up after viewings and help interested customers proceed toward a purchase application

• Keep accurate records of customer conversations, follow-ups, and next steps

• Escalate questions about pricing, negotiations, contracts, or legal matters to our Japan-based team



Compensation:



• Base pay: PHP 12,000 per month

• PHP 12,000 for each completed purchase, payable only after the purchase contract is signed and payment is confirmed



Required Qualifications:



• Hands-on experience in the real estate industry, such as property sales, buyer support, brokerage assistance, property management, or transaction coordination

• Previous residence in Japan

• Practical familiarity with Japanese geography, including areas where you lived or visited

• Strong English communication and customer follow-up skills

• Ability to work 30 hours per week, including Saturday and Sunday coverage

Having visited multiple regions of Japan, speaking Japanese, and having direct real estate sales or closing experience are strong advantages.



Application Requirements:

Your resume

Evidence of your residence in Japan, such as a redacted residence, employment, or school record



A short summary of where you lived in Japan and the areas you know well



One or two anonymized examples of customers or transactions you supported, including your role and the result



You may hide personal identification numbers, exact addresses, customer names, and confidential transaction details. Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a Japan geography exercise and a customer follow-up role-play.



This is a remote contractor position. Official offers, price negotiations, contracts, and legal explanations are handled or approved by our licensed team in Japan.



To apply, please include “JAPAN PROPERTY SALES” in your application message.



SKILL REQUIREMENTS



• Real Estate Sales or Customer Support

• Lead Qualification and Follow-Up

• Customer Communication

• Property Research

• English Communication

description:

Key Responsibilities:

Customer Service & Sales: Handle incoming calls and inquiries from customers. Rent storage units and guide customers through the rental process. Provide outstanding customer service by promptly resolving issues and closing sales with prospective tenants.



Project & Task Management: Manage a variety of projects and tasks across the business. Create and refine processes and systems to improve efficiency (e.g., developing checklists, tracking sheets, SOPs). Stay on top of weekly and monthly to-do lists such as running reports, auditing facility cameras, sending invoices, and following up on delinquent accounts.

You will be responsible for holding the team accountable and stepping in to troubleshoot when things go off-track.

title: Account Manager
description:
Position Summary



The Account Manager is the primary relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of clients. This role protects and grows recurring revenue by understanding each client’s business objectives, ensuring dependable service delivery, resolving issues with urgency, and identifying practical opportunities to expand Barrister’s value. The Account Manager serves as a trusted advisor and internal quarterback, aligning sales, operations, service delivery, finance, and subject-matter experts around measurable client outcomes.



Essential Responsibilities



Client Relationship Ownership & Retention

-Own day-to-day and strategic relationships for assigned accounts, serving as a responsive, dependable point of contact for client stakeholders.

-Build and maintain multi-level relationships with executive sponsors, decision makers, procurement, IT/operations leaders, and end users; create and maintain current relationship maps.

-Develop a thorough understanding of each client’s business model, priorities, operating environment, contractual commitments, and definition of success.

-Conduct regular account touchpoints and formal Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to review performance, risks, business priorities, realized value, and upcoming opportunities.

-Measure and improve client health, satisfaction, retention, and advocacy; actively gather feedback and turn it into clear actions and follow-up communication.

-Anticipate concerns, identify churn or service risks early, and lead timely recovery plans through resolution and client confirmation.



Account Strategy, Revenue Growth & Commercial Management

-Create, maintain, and execute an account business plan for each assigned client, including revenue and margin goals, renewal milestones, growth targets, relationship strategy, risk mitigation, and action owners.

-Identify whitespace and customer needs that can be addressed through appropriate services, solutions, upgrades, renewals, cross-sell, or upsell opportunities.

-Lead consultative discovery and value-based conversations; translate client requirements into practical recommendations, proposals, and measurable business cases.

-Partner with Sales Executives and technical or operational teams to qualify opportunities, develop solutions, prepare pricing and proposals, negotiate within authority, and close business.

-Protect profitability by considering scope, delivery feasibility, service levels, costs, pricing, and contract commitments before making or presenting commitments.

-Drive contract renewal planning well in advance of expiration, including commercial strategy, client alignment, required approvals, and complete CRM documentation.



Service Delivery, Escalation & Internal Leadership

-Coordinate cross-functional resources to ensure products and services are delivered on time, within scope and budget, and in accordance with service-level agreements (SLAs).

-Act as the client advocate internally while balancing client needs with company commitments, operational realities, compliance obligations, and financial goals.

-Lead escalations from initial triage through documented corrective action, regular status communication, root-cause review when appropriate, and confirmed closure.

-Monitor service performance, deliverables, invoicing, scheduling, and key dependencies; promptly escalate material delivery, cost, quality, or compliance risks.

-Participate in client kickoffs, implementation transitions, and service reviews to establish clear expectations, ownership, communication cadence, and success measures.

-Develop and communicate account-level project plans for material client initiatives, clearly defining milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, and completion criteria.

-Standardize and refine delivery processes across the portfolio so strategic clients receive a consistent, high-quality experience.

-Support continuous improvement by identifying recurring issues, process gaps, training needs, and scalable improvements across accounts.



Financial, Data & Pipeline Discipline

-Manage to assigned revenue, retention, margin, renewal, expansion, and customer-experience targets.

-Maintain accurate, timely CRM records for contacts, opportunities, account plans, activities, renewal dates, forecasts, risks, and next steps.

-Review account health and financial performance, including volume trends, utilization, margin, expenses, invoicing, and SLA compliance; flag variances and potential overruns immediately.

-Provide clear weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting and forecasts, including pipeline, renewal outlook, wins, risks, recovery actions, and required leadership support.

-Use client data, industry insight, and internal performance information to prioritize initiatives, substantiate recommendations, and quantify value or return on investment.



Client Enablement & Business Improvement

-Provide or coordinate client-specific education, enablement, and supporting materials that improve adoption, service outcomes, and growth of the company’s offerings.

-Identify and implement service-delivery and account-management improvements that reduce avoidable cost, improve efficiency, and protect the client experience.

-Use formal customer evaluations and feedback channels to validate satisfaction, recognize performance gaps, and drive continuous improvement.

-Maintain appropriate confidentiality and discretion when handling client, commercial, operational, or financial information.



Qualifications



Required

-Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

-3+ years of client-facing account management, customer success, sales, service management, project management, or related experience; experience managing complex B2B accounts preferred.

-Demonstrated ability to build trusted client relationships, retain business, solve problems, and manage several priorities with sound judgment.

-Strong written, verbal, presentation, organizational, analytical, and interpersonal communication skills.

-Ability to work effectively across a matrixed organization and influence internal and external stakeholders at multiple levels.

-Proficiency with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and Microsoft Office, including Excel and PowerPoint.



Preferred

-Experience meeting revenue, renewal, growth, margin, or customer-satisfaction goals within a technology, managed services, IT lifecycle, telecommunications, logistics, or other complex service environment.

-Experience delivering QBRs, account business plans, complex proposals, renewals, and contract negotiations.

-Experience coordinating service delivery, technical, logistics, finance, or operational teams for complex client programs.

-Working knowledge of the company’s relevant solutions, delivery model, competitive landscape, and client industry.



Core Competencies



-Client-centered and consultative: listens carefully, earns credibility, connects solutions to business outcomes, and communicates honestly.

-Commercially accountable: balances client value with revenue, margin, scope, and long-term account health.

-Proactive and organized: anticipates needs, follows through, manages deadlines, and maintains complete documentation.

-Analytical and solutions-oriented: uses data to recognize patterns, diagnose issues, prioritize actions, and improve results.

-Collaborative and resilient: coordinates diverse teams, handles difficult conversations professionally, and remains calm under pressure.

-Ethical and dependable: protects confidential information, honors commitments, follows policies, and exercises sound judgment.



Performance Measures



-Specific targets will be established by leadership based on portfolio type, account maturity, and company priorities. Typical measures include:

-Revenue retention, renewal rate, expansion revenue, quota attainment, and year-over-year growth.

-Portfolio margin, pricing discipline, forecast accuracy, invoice timeliness, and control of avoidable costs or overruns.

-Client satisfaction, Net Promoter Score (NPS) or equivalent feedback, churn, issue-response time, and escalation resolution.

-SLA performance, implementation/service quality, account-plan completion, QBR completion, CRM data quality, and pipeline coverage.

-Quality of executive relationships, client engagement, teamwork, and demonstrated contribution to scalable process improvements.



Work Environment & Additional Information



This position may require occasional travel to client locations, industry events, or internal meetings, depending on portfolio needs. The duties and responsibilities above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed and are not an exhaustive list. Management may assign additional duties consistent with the role and business needs.



Equipment and System Requirements

title: Hiring: Advanced Video Editor — Long-Form YouTube Essays, Reels, Podcasts
description:
About the role



We run a YouTube channel, two instagram pages, and a membership community. We're looking for an editor with real video editing and animation skills, plus the ability to own content editing from raw footage -> long form polished edit -> short form edits and repurposing content as needed.



This is an ongoing, recurring role (per-video or weekly, negotiable) covering the full pipeline: long-form YouTube essays (30–40 min), podcast uploads (just the audio file from the long form content videos), thumbnails, and short-form Reels cut from the long-form material.



Technical requirements



- Dynamic masking & layering: Rotoscope/masking the subject(s) to composite them in front things onscreen

- Comfortable with keyframed mask tracking across moving subjects, not just static crops.

- Pattern interruptions / cutting rhythm: Break up static talking-head footage every few seconds using punch-in zooms, meme splices, and GIF cutaways — timed to beats in the VO, not randomly dropped in.

- Understand pacing well enough to combat attention drop-off across a 30–40 minute runtime without making the edit feel frantic of overdone

- Textual overlays / kinetic typography: Syncing quote cards, text, research citations, etc. over the footage according the the VO

- J-cuts & L-cuts

- color grading

- 2d onscreen stop motion animation

- Multimedia intercutting: intercut archival footage, stock clips, screen recordings, still images, and audio clips within a single sequence — multi-track compositing, not just A/B-roll switching.

- Basic video editing skills, of course





Plus Additional pipeline responsibilities:



- Long-form YouTube editing (using the skills above)

- Short form content editing (reels; using the skills above)

- Repurposing long form content into short form reels

- Content sourcing: Source appropriate footage, imagery, film clips, and reference material (YouTube, Pinterest, archive sites, etc.) that the masking and intercutting techniques above depend on.

- Creating YouTube thumbnails

- Creating Reel covers

- Exporting mp3 files of long form content



Tools/Skills

- A real NLE with compositing capability — Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or After Effects (masking/roto and multi-track work isn't feasible in a transcript-based editor alone; Descript may be used for the initial assembly/transcript-based cut, but final compositing needs a proper timeline tool).

- A thumbnail/graphics tool (Photoshop, Canva, etc.)

- Comfortable sourcing and downloading reference footage/images from YouTube, Pinterest, and archival sources.

- Familiarity with uploading/publishing to YouTube and a podcast host.

- Excellent English proficiency



What I'm looking for in you

- Real command of masking/keying, keyframed text, split edits, and multi-track compositing — not template-based or AI-slop-auto-edit work.

- Can own the full pipeline: raw footage ? composited long-form edit ? thumbnail ? published YouTube video ? podcast upload ? repurposed Reels.

- Strong pacing instincts for long-form (30–40 min) content — know how to keep attention without making the edit feel chaotic.

- Comfortable doing your own research/sourcing for the footage and imagery your composites depend on.

- Precise with instructions like "cut whole sentences only"

- Unique and creative artistic taste and eye. We are not looking for content that looks like everyone else's.



To apply:

Send a reel or examples showing masking/compositing work (subject placed into archival footage or scenes), J-cut/L-cut usage in a long-form piece, and text/citation overlay work.



please note: generic "talking head" video edits or AI content submissions will not be considered.

title: Midterm Rental Manager
description:
About West Coast Homestays

West Coast Homestays is a short-term rental management company operating roughly 80 furnished properties, primarily in San Diego, California. Alongside our nightly stays, a growing share of our portfolio is leased on mid-term stays of 30+ days, including seasonal units that switch between short-term and mid-term depending on the time of year. We're a lean, operations-focused team that cares about guest experience, owner returns, and doing things right the first time.



The Role

We're hiring a Mid-Term Rental (MTR) Agent to fully own our mid-term rental program from first inquiry to final rent payment. You'll be the single point of accountability for every MTR unit in the portfolio, year-round and seasonal: keeping listings live and accurate, turning leads into signed leases, building relationships with housing partners, and making sure rent is collected on time.



This is a high-ownership role for someone who is organized, persistent with follow-ups, comfortable negotiating, and excited to grow occupancy and revenue on a portfolio that's scaling.



What You'll Own:

-Listings & Inventory

-Create, maintain, and optimize MTR listings across mid-term channels (e.g., Furnished Finder, Airbnb monthly stays, Zillow/rental sites, corporate housing networks)

-Keep photos, descriptions, amenities, availability, and pricing accurate and consistent across every channel

-Manage the calendar for seasonal properties, coordinating with the STR team on when units move between short-term and mid-term use

-Flag listing gaps or upcoming vacancies early so units aren't sitting empty



Leads & Follow-Up

-Respond quickly to all inbound MTR inquiries via
, platform messaging, phone, and text

-Qualify leads (dates, budget, occupants, pets, purpose of stay) and match them to the right unit

-Run a disciplined follow-up cadence so no lead goes cold

-Track every lead and its status in our CRM/pipeline from first contact to close



Tours & Showings

-Schedule and coordinate tours, both virtual (video walkthroughs) and in-person through local team members

-Confirm tour times with prospects and on-the-ground staff, and send reminders

-Follow up promptly after every tour to move prospects toward a signed lease



Pricing & Negotiation

-Set and update MTR rates based on seasonality, demand, comparable listings, and occupancy targets

-Negotiate rates, lease terms, and move-in dates with tenants and partners within approved guidelines

-Recommend pricing changes to leadership with supporting data



Housing Partner Relationships

-Proactively build and maintain relationships with housing partners: insurance/ALE (additional living expense) housing providers and adjusters, travel nurse and medical staffing agencies, corporate relocation firms, military housing contacts, and similar sources of mid-term demand

-Respond to partner placement requests quickly with available inventory and quotes

-Grow a repeat-placement pipeline so partners come to us first



Leases & Move-In

-Prepare, send, and get leases and rental agreements signed electronically

-Collect required documents, deposits, and screening/verification items before move-in

-Coordinate move-in and move-out logistics with cleaning, maintenance, and guest-experience teams

-Handle lease extensions, early terminations, and renewals



Rent Collection & Tracking

-Track rent payments, deposits, and partner invoices for every active MTR

-Send payment reminders and follow up on late or missed payments

-Maintain accurate records and reconcile payments with our finance/bookkeeping team

-Escalate collection issues to leadership when needed



Reporting

-Keep a live view of MTR occupancy, pipeline, upcoming vacancies, and rent status

-Share a weekly update with leadership on leads, conversions, revenue, and issues



How Success Is Measured

-MTR occupancy rate and vacant days between stays

-Lead response time and lead-to-lease conversion rate

-Average monthly rate achieved vs. target

-On-time rent collection rate

-Number of active housing partners and repeat placements



What We're Looking For:

-2+ years of experience in property management, leasing, mid-term or corporate housing, short-term rentals, or a similar sales/leasing role

-Excellent written and spoken English; confident communicating with U.S. tenants, partners, and adjusters by phone,
, and text

-Proven track record of lead management and persistent, professional follow-up

-Comfortable negotiating rates and terms

-Highly organized, with strong attention to detail across many units and deadlines at once

Nice to Have

The job



You call property managers, retirement homes, commercial buildings, plumbers and HVAC companies in the Greater Toronto Area. You log every call and next step in our CRM (GoHighLevel).

You also answer or call back inbound emergency leads quickly, and qualify them using our playbook.



Why solar or restoration?



Solar setters: booking a solar site visit and booking a restoration meeting are the same skill. You reach the property owner or decision-maker, handle “we already have someone” or “not now”, and lock a time. We’ll train you on restoration.

Restoration setters: you already know water damage, insurance claims and property managers. You’ll be productive from week one.

Excellent spoken English, easy to understand

Quiet workspace and stable internet

Other B2B cold calling with decision-makers

Insurance or property claims (BPO counts)

Xactimate



Pay

Paid 4-week trial.

About Us

We are a revenue management consultancy for short-term and vacation rental operators. We help property managers and owners grow revenue through data-driven pricing, sharp market strategy, and hands-on account management. Our clients trust us to run pricing on their portfolios day to day and to give them a clear picture of performance and opportunity.



The Role

We're hiring an experienced Revenue Manager to own a book of client accounts end to end. You'll set and execute pricing strategy in PriceLabs, analyze performance, build and present reports, and serve as the primary point of contact for your clients. This is a highly skilled role: we're looking for someone who already knows how to move RevPAR, can explain the "why" behind every pricing decision, and is confident leading client conversations.



What You'll Own



Pricing Strategy & Execution

• Own client accounts in PriceLabs: setup, onboarding, base/min/max prices, customizations, seasonal profiles, occupancy-based adjustments, orphan-day and last-minute rules, and minimum-stay settings

• Set the overall revenue strategy for each client portfolio based on market data, booking pace, seasonality, events, and client goals

• Make ongoing pricing updates and adjustments to respond to pace, pickup, and market shifts

• Monitor booking windows, length of stay, occupancy, ADR, and RevPAR, and act quickly on underperformance

• Identify and price around demand drivers such as holidays, events, conferences, and school calendars



Market & Performance Analysis

• Run competitive set and market analyses using PriceLabs Market Dashboards, AirDNA, Key Data, or similar tools

• Track pacing against last year and against the market, and diagnose the root cause of gaps

• Recommend non-pricing revenue levers to clients: listing optimization, channel mix, minimum-stay strategy, amenities, and positioning



Reporting

• Build and maintain recurring client performance reports (weekly/monthly) covering occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, pace, and forecast

• Translate data into clear insights and next steps that clients can act on

• Keep internal dashboards and account notes up to date



Client Management

• Serve as the primary point of contact for your client accounts

• Lead regular strategy calls and performance reviews with clients

• Onboard new clients: gather goals, audit current pricing and listings, and implement an initial strategy

• Set expectations, handle questions and pushback professionally, and build long-term trust

• Identify opportunities to expand services and retain clients



Team & Process

• Contribute to internal playbooks, pricing standards, and best practices

• Share market insights with the team and help raise the bar across the consultancy



How Success Is Measured

• Revenue and RevPAR growth for client portfolios, year over year and vs. market

• Occupancy and ADR performance against targets and comp sets

• Client retention and satisfaction

• Timeliness and quality of reports and pricing updates



What We're Looking For

Required

• 4+ years of revenue management experience, ideally in short-term or vacation rentals (hotel RM experience also considered)

• Proven track record of increasing revenue performance, with examples and results you can walk us through

• Advanced, hands-on experience with PriceLabs

• Strong command of RM metrics and concepts: ADR, occupancy, RevPAR, pace, pickup, booking window, LOS, and forecasting

• Strong analytical skills and advanced Excel / Google Sheets

• Excellent written and spoken English; confident leading client meetings and presenting results

• Highly organized and able to manage multiple client portfolios at once

description:
About Boost1

Boost1 Enterprises is a US credit repair company. We help clients clean up inaccurate, unverifiable, and outdated items on their credit reports, then build toward funding. We run on a team of AI agents plus a small human team. The agents handle lead intake, credit report analysis, daily ops reports, and deadline tracking, while people approve every dispute letter before it goes out. The founder built most of this himself. Now we need a right hand who can pressure-test it, harden it, and help us scale it.



What you'll work on



- Audit our AI agent team. Review how our agents for leads, report analysis, ops, and compliance hand work off to each other, and show us where things break, overlap, or leak data.

- Client onboarding automation. Build the flow from signed contract to payment, docs collected, and report pulled, with every step tracked in 
 and Notion.

- Dispute workflow. Build automations around our letter process (drafted, approved, sent), plus tracking for rounds and the 30-day bureau response window. A human approves every letter, and that never changes.

- Deadline and compliance alerts. Make sure cancellation windows, response deadlines, and renewals never slip.

- Lead pipeline. Improve how WhatsApp and web leads get captured, qualified, and followed up on.

- Privacy and security. Sensitive client data (SSNs, dates of birth, account numbers, full reports) must stay locked inside our credit repair software and never leak into chats, docs, or AI tools. You'll help us enforce that, and set up access controls and audit trails.

- Documentation. Write a clear SOP for everything you build.



Our stack

Credit Repair Cloud, CreditHeroScore, 
 (including a custom bot), Notion, Google Workspace, Commas (payments), WhatsApp, Claude, and other LLM-based agents.



What we're looking for



- Proven work building AI agents and automations (n8n, Make, Zapier, APIs, 
 bots, LLMs). Real examples required.

- A privacy-first mindset. Experience in finance, legal, health, or another regulated field is a big plus.

- You understand that credit repair is heavily regulated (FCRA, CROA), so nothing gets automated that skips human approval or makes promises we can't make.

- Clear written English. You tell us straight when something's wrong.

- Reliable and responsive during agreed hours, with at least a few hours of overlap with US Eastern time.

- Bonus: experience with Credit Repair Cloud, CRMs, or 
 bot development.



Pay and structure



- Start with paid flat-fee projects. You'll do a couple of scoped projects for a flat fee, and we'll agree on the scope and price before each one.

- Then ongoing hourly work at $10 to $22 an hour, based on skill and results. Expect about 10 to 20 hours a week to start, with room to grow.

title: AI Systems Architect
description:
Remote · Full-time · Eastern Time Schedule . ₱100,000–₱115,000/month depending on experience + HMO + 10 days paid leave after 6 months,



About the role:



We're looking for a hands-on AI Systems Architect to design, build and run the AI foundation our whole organization will work on.



You'll shape how our teams and clients use AI agents day to day, so people spend less time on repetitive work and more time on work that matters. This is a build role, not an advisory one. You'll write production code, make the architecture calls and set the standards others build on.

If you enjoy turning messy business workflows into reliable, secure AI systems, and you care whether they actually make people's work better, we'd like to hear from you.



What you'll do:



• Design our AI architecture. Set the standards for models, agents, orchestration, memory, tools, data access and human review.

• Build AI agents that work in production. Create agents, multi-agent systems and reusable services that teams can rely on.

• D
 what AI should and shouldn't do. Choose when work belongs to an AI agent, regular software, an automated workflow or a person.

• Set up how people work with agents. Define each agent's job, tools, permissions and escalation rules, and how people assign, review and accept its work.

• Keep things secure across clients. Design a multi-client setup that keeps each client's data separate and protects confidential information.

• Measure quality. Build evaluation and testing that tracks accuracy, reliability, cost, speed and rework, and catches hallucinations and bad recommendations.

• Guard against AI-specific risks. Handle prompt injection, data leakage and unauthorized tool use, with clear audit trails and human approval where it counts.

• Turn business needs into working systems. Translate requirements into workflows, integrations and clear acceptance criteria.

• Lead and coach developers. Give direction, review work and help others build with the patterns you set.

• Solve the hard problems yourself. Stay close enough to the code to understand real effort and risk.



What you'll bring:



•5+ years of professional software engineering, including at least 2 years building AI/LLM systems used by real users or clients

• A track record of building AI agents or multi-agent systems

• Strong hands-on software engineering skills and experience with enterprise or platform architecture

• Practical experience with LLMs, structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval and orchestration

• Experience connecting AI systems to applications, databases, knowledge sources and APIs

• Experience building evaluation, testing and quality checks for AI

• Experience with authentication, permissions, audit logging and data protection

• Experience deploying, monitoring and supporting AI systems in production

• A history of turning business workflows into secure technical solutions and leading delivery

• Evidence that your work produced measurable improvements in operations, productivity or revenue

We don't require any particular framework, model provider or vendor. We care that you choose tools based on security, reliability, cost and business need.



Nice to have:



• A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

• Experience with multi-client or multi-tenant platforms

• Experience building reusable AI products or platform capabilities

• Experience with knowledge architecture, semantic systems or advanced retrieval

• Experience in a growing company where systems and standards are still taking shape



How you work:



• You think in systems and enjoy rolling up your sleeves to solve problems.

• You're open about your assumptions and blind spots, and you make uncertainty visible.

• You're comfortable making progress with incomplete information.

• You explain technical ideas clearly to both engineers and non-technical colleagues.

• You take security, evidence, quality and human accountability seriously.

• You challenge assumptions constructively, including knowing when AI isn't the right answer.

• You care about outcomes, not just activity.

• You build systems others can use without needing you in the loop.



What success looks like:



• A secure, reusable AI architecture is in place and well understood.

• AI agents do approved work reliably, within clear permissions.

• Everyone knows what AI handles, what people review and when to escalate.

• Teams produce more useful work with less repetition and rework.

• AI costs, risks and performance are visible and under control.

• Developers deliver AI features faster using the patterns you set.

• Our AI capabilities deliver measurable benefits for the business and our clients.



How to apply

Send your CV and a short note about an AI system you built and the results it delivered.

title: Appointment Setter | WFH | UK Estate Agency

Lettings

• Call tenants and applicants to book property viewings

• Support the lettings team with follow up calls when needed

• Log every call, outcome and note in our CRM (
)

Targets and Reporting

• Hit daily call targets and weekly booked appointment targets

• Share call outcomes and feedback to help improve our scripts and lead sources



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should have:



• At least 1 year of experience calling for an estate agency, letting agency or real estate business (UK experience strongly preferred; US, Australian or Canadian real estate also considered)

• Proven appointment-setting results you can tell us about: calls per day and appointments booked

• Excellent spoken English, clear and confident on the phone

• Comfortable with rejection and with handling objections in real time

• Good understanding of how property sales and lettings work: valuations, viewings, landlords, tenants and applicants

• Experience using a CRM and a VoIP dialler

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS



Competitive Pay and Bonuses

• Annual performance and pay review

• Appointment bonus for booked appointments that go ahead, available after 12 months of service and subject to agreed KPIs



Bonuses and Incentives

• Thirteenth month pay

• Fourteenth month performance bonus after five years of service

• Bonus days off every 80 hours worked after probation



Long-Term Growth and Stability

• Paid training and career development

• Health stipend after two years of service

• Company loan options after two years of service

• Guaranteed pay security: if we do not provide enough work, you will still be paid for at least 75 percent of your contracted hours



HOW TO APPLY



• Complete this short application form:

• Only applications made through the Google Form will be accepted. Applications sent only through OnlineJobs.ph will not be reviewed.

• The form includes a short voice recording. Applications without the recording will not be reviewed.

• No CV required at this stage.



HIRING TIMELINE



The job posting will close on 13th December 2026 at 11:59 PM UK time. We will review the applications received over the following days and let applicants know the results by 18th December.



Shortlisted candidates will then receive an invite to complete a trial task, due in the first week of January. For candidates who advance, interviews will take place in the 2nd or 3rd week of January. We aim to make a final decision by the end of January, and the successful candidate will begin in the 1st or 2nd week of February.



Note: This timeline may adjust slightly as we progress, especially around the Christmas holidays. We'll keep you informed.



Thank you for your patience and enthusiasm. Join us and grow your career with a UK based estate agency.

title: Commercial Funding Operations Coordinator
description:
At Teal Bay Capital, we help move commercial lending and capital-raise opportunities from intake through closing. You’ll support the back-office funding work and coordinate with borrowers, brokers, lenders, and family-office contacts.



What you’ll do

• Enter new opportunities in Zoho CRM and keep each deal’s stage, owner, next action, and due date current.

• Request and collect borrower documents for commercial real estate loans, including financial statements, bank statements, tax returns, entity and ownership records, debt schedules, collateral documents, and property records as applicable.

• Review financial statements and other documents for completeness and consistency, and flag discrepancies for review.

• Track outstanding items and borrower responses, and escalate delays in document collection.

• Build underwriting and due diligence packages with a deal summary, document index, financial schedules, and a list of open items.

• Coordinate submissions, outstanding conditions, and closing documentation, and organize loan files.

• Use approved channels to collect, store, and share confidential records.

• Maintain broker and family-office contact records, prepare meeting briefs, coordinate introductions, and follow up on commitments.



What we need

We need an experienced candidate who has supported commercial lending or other business-purpose funding. Experience supporting capital raises or working with family offices is a plus. You should understand how a deal moves from intake and diligence through submission, closing, and funding, and have hands-on experience managing contacts, deals, tasks, and pipeline updates in Zoho CRM.



You’ll communicate clearly and professionally in spoken and written English when following up with borrowers and brokers, explaining document requirements, and discussing missing items. You’ll use Microsoft Word and Microsoft Excel to prepare submission summaries, checklists, trackers, and financial schedules. Adobe Acrobat can also be useful in this work.



We value clear communication, ownership, and steady follow-through. Funding priorities can shift quickly, so we rely on you to keep Zoho CRM current, flag delays early, and make sure every active deal has a clear next step. You’ll handle sensitive borrower information and use sound judgment when doing so.



Careful, consistent, and dependable. You follow a clear process, notice discrepancies, and stay patient and persistent when collecting outstanding documents.



This role calls for judgment and ownership beyond basic data entry. Good work means complete, well-organized underwriting packages, with financial statements and applicable property and entity records checked for completeness and consistency.



The role starts in back-office funding operations and can grow into direct client communication, broker account support, and capital partner relationship coordination. A performance bonus is offered.



Hours

We work 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. US Central time, 40 hours a week. This is a night shift in the Philippines, typically 11 p.m. to 7 a.m. Philippine time.



We expect this role to start in the coming weeks. This is an independent contractor role. We review every application and invite the best fits to an interview.



Pay: $800.00 per month



To apply, please include the following:

• Write a brief email asking a broker for the borrower’s latest P&L and signed operating agreement by Friday.



Please answer these questions:

What commercial funding deal did you support, and what documents did you review for submission?

How have you used Zoho CRM, Word, and Excel to manage funding deals?

Have you worked with family offices?

title: Part-Time QA Tester (Web + iPhone + Android) for Home Staging Software. Record Your Sessions
description:
StageEngine is software that runs home staging companies: their furniture inventory, jobs, proposals, contracts, invoices and payments. We're a small US company in California. We need a careful manual tester who enjoys trying to break things, every week, on a real iPhone, a real Android phone and a computer.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Every week we put a new version of the app on our test site. Within 48 hours, work through that week's checklist (usually 30-80 checks) and mark each one pass, fail or blocked.

- Then use the app the way a staging company's office manager would (quote a job, send a contract, bill a client, check furniture in and out) and find where it breaks or where a real user would get stuck.

- Write clear bug reports: the steps, what you expected, what happened, the device, and the time in your recording.



WHAT YOU NEED

- At least 1 year of manual testing on web or mobile apps. SaaS is a plus; billing, invoicing or payment apps are a big plus.

- A working iPhone AND an Android phone of your own, plus a computer.

- Clear written English.

- You're comfortable recording your screen and talking through what you're doing. EVERY session is recorded, with your voice. This is required, and it's paid time.

- About 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday. Some overlap with US Pacific mornings (your late evening) is a plus.



PAY

- $550 a month base for about 20 hours a week.

- Plus a bonus for each confirmed bug that our own automated (AI) testing missed: $10 for a serious bug, $3 for a small one, up to $150 a month.

- Paid twice a month. It starts with a paid 2-hour trial on the real app.



HOW TO APPLY (applications missing any of these are skipped)

1. Put the word SANDPIPER in the first line of your application.

2. Tell us which iPhone model and which Android phone you own.

3. Include a link to a 1-2 minute screen recording (Loom or Google Drive) of you testing the sign-up page of any website, talking through what you check and what you would report.

title: Remote TAP Series Sales Setter (PST Hours)

Remote TAP Sales Setter (PST Hours) 

The Remote TAP Sales Setter plays a crucial role in driving lead generation and appointment setting for TAP’s training programs. Working Pacific Time (PST) hours in a fully remote capacity, you will focus on connecting with instructors affiliated with the American Culinary Association who prepare students for the Food Safety Manager Certification. Through proactive outreach, including direct messaging on social platforms and cold calling via OpenPhone, you will introduce these instructors to TAP’s solutions and schedule product demo meetings with our Learning Managers. The ideal candidate is a self- motivated communicator who can ask insightful questions about instructors’ current training outcomes (e.g., “What is your passing rate?” or “How much time do you spend teaching the Food Safety Manager Certification?”) and highlight how TAP’s training prepares learners to pass on the first attempt. This role is key to expanding TAP’s impact by ensuring prospective clients understand our value and are eager to learn more in a scheduled demo. 



What you'll do:

Key Responsibilities



· Lead Generation & Outreach: Identify and prospect American Culinary Association instructors via social media channels (Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn). Initiate direct message conversations and conduct cold calls using contact data provided through OpenPhone to introduce TAP’s training offerings and gauge interest.



· Qualifying Prospects: Engage in consultative conversations by asking targeted questions about the instructor’s current program, such as student passing rates and the time invested in teaching the Food Safety Manager Certification.



· Value Proposition Communication: Clearly articulate TAP’s benefits, emphasizing that our courses help learners pass certification exams on their first attempt.



· Appointment Setting: Schedule and coordinate demo appointments between interested instructor prospects and TAP’s Learning Managers, adhering to PST availability. Confirm appointments with prospects.



· CRM Tracking: Diligently document all interactions, notes, and appointment details in Salesforce. Maintain an organized pipeline of leads.



· Collaboration: Work closely with Learning Managers and the sales team to smoothly transition qualified leads. Share relevant prospect insights gathered during outreach.



· Performance & Follow-up: Meet or exceed weekly and monthly targets for outreach and booked appointments. Follow up post-demo as needed.





 

What we're looking for:

Qualifications

· Experience: Previous sales development, appointment setting, or lead generation experience (remote preferred). Experience with cold outreach and social media prospecting strongly preferred.



· Social Media & Cold Calling Skills: Proficiency with Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and comfort conducting cold calls through OpenPhone.



· Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication. Strong active listening skills ssential.



· Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with culinary education or certification training advantageous.



· CRM Proficiency: Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM tools for lead tracking.



· Self-Motivated & Results-Driven: Ability to independently manage time and meet appointment targets.



· Interpersonal Skills: Positive, resilient, and adaptable.



· Availability: Must work Pacific Time hours. Reliable internet and remote workspace required.



Would be a plus:

Compensation Details



This role offers performance-based compensation, with $25 paid for each appointment set that converts into a paying customer. This incentivizes effective appointment setting and rewards results.

title: Security Compliance Program Lead
description:
About the Engagement



We're pursuing SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certification concurrently, on a fixed schedule, and need someone to take the program from kickoff to a clean report/certificate — then hand off a running program to an internal owner.



Two dates anchor the engagement and do not move: the ISO 27001 certificate in March 2027 and the SOC 2 Type II report in May 2027. There's no slack before January, so month one is spent locking auditor commitments, not writing documents.



This is a hands-on individual contributor role, not a supervisory one. You'll write the policies, chase the evidence, and sit in the audit meetings yourself — working across engineering, IT, HR, legal, and field operations, none of whom report to you. The work runs on influence and follow-through, not authority.



Key Deliverables

-ISMS scope statement and SOC 2 system description — Due Nov 2026 / Jan 2027

-Risk assessment (ISO 27001 clause 6.1) + risk treatment plan — Due Dec 2026

-Approved policy set (~20 policies, Annex A structure) — Due Nov 2026

-Statement of Applicability, all 93 Annex A controls — Due Dec 2026

-Compliance platform configured and collecting evidence — Due Nov 2026

-Remediation complete and evidenced across all teams — Due Dec 2026

-Vendor risk register, third-party reports, signed DPAs — Due Dec 2026

-Penetration test commissioned; critical findings closed — Due Dec 2026

-ISMS internal audit and management review documented — Due Dec 2026

-SOC 2 Type I report issued — Due Jan 2027

-ISO 27001 certificate issued — Due Mar 2027

-SOC 2 Type II report issued, no material exceptions — Due May 2027

-Handover pack + trained internal owner — Due Jun 2027



What You'll Do

-Own the program plan, schedule, and budget; report progress to leadership monthly

-Contract and manage the CPA firm and certification body — scheduling, evidence requests, walkthroughs, findings/responses

-Define and document one scope boundary serving both frameworks

-Write the policies, Statement of Applicability, and system description

-Drive cross-team remediation (access control, logging, encryption, change management, onboarding/offboarding), holding owners to dates and escalating early

-Administer the compliance automation platform and keep evidence collection running

-Run vendor risk reviews; collect third-party reports and DPAs

-Coordinate the penetration test, internal audit, and management review

-Document the running program and train the internal owner who takes it on
