title: Credit Repair Dispute Specialist (FCRA, Credit Repair Cloud), Remote
description:
About Boost1 Enterprises

Boost1 Enterprises helps US clients fix their credit. We challenge inaccurate, unverifiable, or outdated items on credit reports, and we serve adults 18 and older in the United States. Our line is "Fix your credit. Unlock your lifestyle." Learn more at 



This is process-driven work. We do not promise specific results or score changes.



The Role

You will own our dispute and letter work. You review credit reports, identify items that qualify for dispute, draft FCRA-based letters and complaints, and send them once our founder approves them, following our SOPs. This is a remote role. It does not include sales, lead follow-up, billing, or intake calls, and it is not a general virtual assistant position.



Responsibilities



- Review credit reports and identify items that are inaccurate, unverifiable, or outdated.

- Dispute qualifying items, including collections, charge-offs, late payments, hard inquiries, medical items, liens, judgments, repossessions, foreclosures, and bankruptcies.

- Draft bureau dispute letters to Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion, round by round, and send each round once it's approved.

- Track 30-day bureau response deadlines and escalate to the next round (including certified mail) when a bureau doesn't respond.

- Draft creditor and furnisher letters, cease-and-desist letters, goodwill letters, and CFPB complaints when the file calls for them. CFPB complaints are submitted only after founder approval and the client's written authorization.

- Log every letter and action in Credit Repair Cloud the same day, and post round updates in our team 
.



Requirements



- Hands-on experience with US credit repair and FCRA-based disputes.

- Experience with Credit Repair Cloud or a similar credit repair CRM.

- Strong written English.

- High attention to detail and same-day logging.

- Able to keep client information confidential.

- Your own computer, reliable internet, and a quiet place to work.



Preferred skills



- Experience sending letters through Credit Repair Cloud mail.

- Experience with CFPB complaints, cease-and-desist letters, and goodwill letters.

- CreditHeroScore experience.

- Comfort using 
.



Tools



- Credit Repair Cloud: CRM, letters, mailing, and client portal

- CreditHeroScore: credit reports and monitoring

- 
: team chat and client files

- WhatsApp: quick team messages only, never client data

- Notion: internal SOPs



Schedule



- Remote and flexible. Volume starts smaller and grows as we add clients.

- Most work is asynchronous in Credit Repair Cloud and 
. You need to be reachable and able to meet 30-day bureau deadlines.

- Some overlap with US Eastern time is a plus.



Pay



- Paid per completed piece of work, weekly:

  - $10 to $15 USD per approved dispute letter, based on experience and accuracy

  - A flat rate per approved CFPB complaint, shared at hire

- Performance bonuses for accuracy and on-time work, details shared at hire.

- Only approved, sent work is paid. Letters with errors or ineligible items must be redone at no extra pay.

- Every letter and action must be logged in Credit Repair Cloud the same day.

- Independent contractor. You'll sign an independent contractor agreement with a confidentiality clause.



How we work



- You'll complete our SOP training before you touch live client files.

- SSNs, dates of birth, account numbers, full reports, and logins stay inside Credit Repair Cloud and CreditHeroScore only. They are never pasted into 
, WhatsApp,
, chat apps, AI tools, or anywhere else.

- We never dispute on an identity-theft basis without the client's own FTC identity theft report or police report. You will never file FTC reports or police reports for a client.

- You won't message clients directly. Our founder approves every client-facing message.



How to apply

Apply only through OnlineJobs.ph. Start your first message with BOOST1 so we know you read this post. Then include:



1. Your years of US credit repair or dispute experience.

2. Whether you've used Credit Repair Cloud, and for how long.

3. A 3 to 6 sentence answer: when would you dispute an item, and when would you leave it alone?

4. Optional: redacted sample letters only. Remove all client names, account numbers, Social Security numbers, and other private data.

ing US vendors

title: Cybersecurity Lead (Application and Infrastructure Security), Long-Term Partnership Opportunity
description:
Quick note: Before sending in your application, please make sure to read all the instructions in our "How to Apply" section. Any applications with missing items from our instructions will not be entertained.



ABOUT MSTR



MSTR is an AI software company based in the Netherlands and an Anthropic partner. We build custom AI software for Dutch businesses, run programs that bring AI into daily use, and ship our own products.



We are 20+ people, with a customer-facing team in the Netherlands and a remote development team in the Philippines. Our clients include municipalities, accountants, law firms and enterprise companies.



WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS



Security work is currently shared by our infra and DevOps teams, alongside their main jobs. We want one person to own it end to end, set the standard, and be able to block a release.



This is a long-term career opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with us, not find their next gig. You start as our security lead and build this into a small department over time.



LOCATION AND WORKING SET-UP

- Remote

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, 3:00 p.m - 12:00 a.m Philippine time (overlapping with Netherlands business hours)

- Long-term contractor position



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Dependency and supply-chain hygiene across all repos: Dependabot or Renovate, npm/pip/NuGet audits, SBOMs, a fixed patch cadence, and triaging what is actually exploitable

- Pentesting our own products and the custom builds for clients, before release and on a recurring schedule

- Security checks in CI: SAST, secrets scanning, container and IaC scanning, and DAST against staging

- Cloud and platform posture on Azure and Supabase: identity and access, row-level security (RLS), network exposure, key management

- AI-specific risks: prompt injection, MCP and tool permissions, data leaking through LLM calls, and which model providers may see client data

- Own i
 response and a vulnerability disclosure process

- Support enterprise security questionnaires and compliance (GDPR, NIS2, ISO 27001 readiness)

- Build security into a small department over time and set the rules the developers follow



HOW WE SPLIT THE WORK

- DevOps runs the platform. Security sets policy, finds issues, checks the fixes, and has veto on releases.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Must-have:

- At least 4 years in application security or pentesting, with real findings you can walk us through

- Strong grip on the OWASP Top 10 and the OWASP LLM Top 10

- Hands-on with Burp Suite or similar

- Can read and fix code in our stacks: TypeScript/React/Next, Python, .NET, Postgres

- Azure security experience

- Supabase experience

- You write clear findings that a developer can act on and a client can read

- You take ownership without being chased. This is a lead role, not an assistant role.

- Excellent English communication, written and verbal



Nice-to-have:

- OSCP, OSWE, BSCP or an Azure security certification

- A bug bounty track record

- Has gone through ISO 27001 or SOC 2 with a company

- Has used Claude Code for security review



AI tools are welcome. We are an AI company. If you use Claude, Claude Code or similar tools for code review or security work, tell us how. We would rather hire someone who uses AI well than someone who avoids it.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Long-term partnership: we are investing in your future with us

- Build something from scratch: you set up the security function, with direct access to the leadership team

- Real authority: you have veto on releases

- Interesting problems: application, infrastructure and AI security in one role

- A clear growth path: build and lead a small security department

- Continuous learning: work at an Anthropic partner, with Claude as part of your daily work

- Flexible remote work

- A team that moves fast and takes quality seriously



OUR STACK

- Cloud and platform: Azure, Supabase

- Languages and frameworks: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Python, .NET

- Database: Postgres



HOW TO APPLY

IMPORTANT: We assess candidates primarily through video responses. Please do not apply without submitting a video.



Step 1: Create a short video (3 to 7 minutes)



Record yourself answering these 5 questions:



1. Tell us about yourself: Briefly introduce yourself and how you got into application security.

2. A finding you are proud of: Walk us through a real vulnerability you found. How did you find it, what was the impact, and how did you get it fixed? Leave out anything confidential.

3. Stopping a release: Tell us about a time you had to say "this can't go live yet". How did you explain it, and how did you get the team on your side?

4. Securing AI: An AI assistant at a client can read their documents and use tools through MCP. What are the main risks, including which model providers may see client data, and what would you check first?

5. Your next role: What would you like to achieve in your next role? Where do you see yourself in 5 to 10 years?



Video guidelines:

- Length: 3 to 7 minutes in total

- Production: no need for professional quality, we want to see the real you

- Authenticity: it's fine to use AI to prepare, but talk to us in your own words. Please don't read from a script.

- Language: English (this assesses your communication skills)

- Format: any video format is fine (MP4, MOV, etc.)

- Hosting: upload to Google Drive, Dropbox, YouTube (unlisted) or similar



Step 2: Submit your application

Send the following to 
 and 



1. Your video (link or attachment)

2. Your CV / resume

3. Optional: certifications, bug bounty profile, GitHub, LinkedIn, or an anonymized finding report you wrote



 subject: "Security Lead Application - [Your Name]"



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

1. We review your video and CV within 2 to 3 days

2. If you are a strong match, we schedule an initial interview

3. Successful candidates move to a technical evaluation

4. Final candidates meet with our founder

5. We aim to complete the entire process in 1 to 2 weeks



WHO SHOULD APPLY

Apply if you:

- Want a long-term career in a high-performance organization

- Like setting up structure where there is none yet

- Take ownership without being chased

- Are curious about AI and the new security risks it brings



Don't apply if you:

- Only want short-term gigs or are juggling multiple clients

- Aren't willing to create a video response

- Don't have hands-on application security or pentesting experience



Ready to apply? Send your video and CV to 
 and 
 are happy to answer any questions.



We look forward to learning more about you.

title: Property Maintenance & Field Operations Supervisor / Manager

Barrister Premier Properties, LLC

Barrister Premier Properties, LLC is seeking an experienced, hands-on Property Maintenance & Field Operations Supervisor / Manager to take ownership of maintenance and field operations across our portfolio of multifamily apartments, hotels, shopping centers, commercial properties, and tenant spaces throughout the Northshore.



We are looking for someone with strong construction and property maintenance experience who can diagnose problems, determine the correct repair solution, lead a 3–4 person in-house maintenance crew, manage work orders, procure materials, and personally perform or assist with repairs when needed.



Key Responsibilities



-Manage, assign, prioritize, and track daily maintenance work orders.

-Lead, supervise, and hold accountable a 3–4 person in-house maintenance crew.

-Diagnose building, construction, and maintenance issues and determine the appropriate repair solution.

-Create scopes of work, material lists, and basic material takeoffs.

-Purchase and stage materials ahead of scheduled work and respond quickly to emergency material needs.

-Perform hands-on repairs and maintenance alongside the crew when necessary.

-Conduct regular property walks and inspections to identify maintenance needs before they become larger problems.

-Perform tenant and resident move-out inspections and coordinate turnover work.

-Establish and maintain preventative maintenance schedules across the portfolio.

-Respond to emergency maintenance issues and prioritize work based on urgency, safety, property damage exposure, and operational impact.

-Track outstanding repairs and ensure work is completed properly, timely, and to company standards.

-Coordinate with outside subcontractors when work requires specialized trades or additional manpower.

-Verify completed work and maintain accountability for quality, materials, labor, and company resources.

-Take full ownership of maintenance issues from initial diagnosis through final completion.



Qualifications



-5+ years of experience in construction, property maintenance, facilities maintenance, or maintenance supervision.

-Strong working knowledge of multiple trades, including:

            -Carpentry and general construction

            -Plumbing

            -Electrical

            -HVAC

            -Drywall

            -Painting and finishes

-Proven ability to lead and manage maintenance or construction personnel.

-Experience preparing scopes of work, material takeoffs, and purchasing materials.

-Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving ability.

-Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple active work orders and properties simultaneously.

-Comfortable working in the field daily and performing hands-on work when required.

-Reliable transportation and a clean driving record.

-Strong communication skills and professional presence when interacting with tenants, residents, vendors, subcontractors, and company personnel.



Ideal Candidate



-We are looking for someone who is hands-on, dependable, organized, decisive, and accountable.

-The right candidate should be able to walk into a property, identify the problem, determine the appropriate solution, obtain the necessary materials, assign or perform the work, and make sure the job is completed correctly.

-You should be comfortable making decisions in the field, working under pressure, managing competing priorities, leading a crew, and treating company properties, materials, equipment, and resources as if they were your own.

-We want someone who does not simply identify problems or pass them along. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of the problem and drives it through completion.

-This position is critical to establishing and maintaining a reliable, organized, responsive, and accountable in-house property maintenance operation across the Barrister Premier Properties portfolio.

Escalate stuck, lost or damaged parcels to our fulfillment partner

Flag tricky cases to your lead instead of guessing

Spot patterns and report them, like repeat sizing complaints on one SKU, damage clusters from one supplier, or anything that points to a product problem rather than a customer problem

Take on refunds, returns and chargeback documentation once you're signed off on the queue



How you'll be trained:

You won't be dropped into the queue alone.

Daily shadowing. In your first weeks, our CS trainer shadows your shifts and reviews your tickets every day until you can work on your own. He also coaches leaders and managers at a large international company. He'll show you how we work and make sure it sticks.

A full written playbook. It covers every case type, store policies, refund and cancellation rules, escalation steps and end-of-shift handover.

Weekly ticket review. Each week we go through real tickets together, so you see what good looks like and improve fast.

AI help on routine tickets. The help desk drafts replies and sends tracking updates on routine cases. You do the human part: reading carefully, catching what's off, and making sure the customer feels looked after.

Access in steps. You start with ticket replies only. Refund rights in Shopify come once you're signed off.



Requirements. These are hard filters:

You have done customer service for a fashion dropshipping store. General e-commerce, SaaS or retail experience doesn't count. We need fashion dropshipping specifically, with the transit times, sizing questions and supplier dependencies that come with it.

Your application names 2–5 stores you have worked with. More is better.

Fluent, native-level written English. You'll be writing to UK, US, EU and Australian customers, and the tone has to fit.

You read the whole ticket before replying. We check this. Canned, copy-paste or duplicate replies are the fastest way out.

You're available for the full fixed shift, Monday to Saturday. You need a quiet workspace and stable internet with a backup for brownouts. We measure and report first-response time.

You're OK with time tracking in Hubstaff.

You are familiar with how Slack works and the logic behind threads.

You've used Gorgias or a similar help desk.

You're confident in Shopify admin: orders, refunds, partial refunds, fulfillments and notes.



How we work:

We're direct and we don't micromanage after the initial starter period. You'll be trained on our processes, you will have a playbook to work with and we expect you to write down what you learn as you go. People who build good notes and bring ideas are the ones who move up here.



What you get:

A long-term ongoing contract, not a one-off project

$5/hour on a 3-6 hour shift (will increase over time the longer you stay in the company, this is for the initial starter period), Monday to Saturday, paid from your first tracked hour, including all training and shadowing

Daily shadowing and live training on our systems, stores and escalation paths, plus a named contact for anything unusual

A real shot at leading the team. Once someone proves they go the extra mile, we promote them to Customer Support Lead with higher pay and their own team to build as we launch new stores.

Rate reviews at 3 and 6 months



To apply:

Start your application with the word TREE. We skip applications that don't.

Your 2–5 named fashion dropshipping stores

Your timezone, and confirmation that you can work the fixed shift Monday to Saturday

The help desk tools you've used, and for how long



Hiring process

We review applications and shortlist the ones that followed the instructions.

You have a short video interview with us and our CS trainer.

We hire 2-3 people, and both start with daily shadowing.

We're not rushing this. Interviews run over a few days, and we'd rather wait for the right people.



We'll add more support hires as stores launch. If you work as part of a team or run a small agency, you're welcome to say so.



Plus point: If you've managed customer service for fashion stores and know fashion dropshipping inside out, we'll review your application first.



We're hiring 2-3 people now. One of you could be running this team next.



Good luck.!

title: Carrier Onboarding Representative
description:
GH Logistics is a growing freight brokerage and asset-based logistics company specializing in dry van and reefer freight. Our strength comes from reliable carrier partnerships, disciplined execution, clean communication, and scalable capacity across the U.S. As our network continues to expand, we are looking for a Carrier Onboarding Representative to help identify, verify, onboard, and develop relationships with reliable trucking carriers across our priority markets.



This role is not just about adding carriers to our network. It is about building a dependable carrier base, maintaining strong relationships, and ensuring our operations teams have access to qualified carriers when capacity is needed.



Role Overview

You are responsible for sourcing, vetting, onboarding, and maintaining relationships with qualified carriers while supporting the growth and reliability of GH Logistics' carrier network. You will work directly with U.S.-based trucking companies to identify carriers operating in our priority markets, verify their qualifications, complete onboarding requirements, and maintain accurate carrier records.



This is a high volume and phone-based role that requires persistence, organization, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced freight environment. This role does not involve booking loads or negotiating freight rates. Your primary responsibility is to ensure qualified, verified carriers are properly onboarded, documented, and connected with the appropriate internal teams. This role is strictly for fluent English speakers, as the position requires constant communication with U.S.-based carriers and internal team members throughout the shift.



What You'll Be Doing



Carrier Sourcing and Network Development

• Make at least 30 outbound calls daily to identify and connect with potential carriers.

• Handle approximately 20 inbound calls daily related to carrier inquiries, onboarding, and follow-ups.

• Identify reliable carriers actively operating in GH Logistics' priority markets.

• Build professional relationships with carrier owners, dispatchers, and fleet representatives.

• Introduce GH Logistics and explain our carrier onboarding process, freight network, and communication expectations.

• Identify carrier operating areas, preferred lanes, equipment types, and availability.

• Follow up with existing carriers to maintain engagement and updated information.

• Focus on developing long-term carrier relationships rather than simply increasing onboarding numbers.



Carrier Verification and Fraud Prevention

• Verify carriers using approved tools

• Review carrier operating authority, insurance coverage, safety records, and compliance information.

• Check the company's Do Not Use (DNU) list before proceeding with onboarding.

• Identify potential red flags involving fraud, double brokering, or suspicious carrier information.

• Ensure all verification requirements are completed before onboarding a carrier.

• Escalate questionable carriers or compliance concerns to management.

• Follow company-approved verification procedures without skipping required steps.



Carrier Onboarding and Documentation

• Successfully onboard at least 3 qualified carriers daily.

• Complete all required carrier onboarding documentation accurately and efficiently.

• Ensure carrier information and compliance records are complete and up to date.

• Create at least 1 group chat daily with a newly onboarded carrier to establish direct communication.

• Immediately post every newly onboarded carrier in the designated channel.

• Ensure every onboarded carrier is properly recorded and accessible to the appropriate internal teams.

• Coordinate with internal teams to ensure newly onboarded carriers are ready for potential freight opportunities.



Carrier Relationship Management and Tracking

• Update and maintain spreadsheet daily.

• Track carrier onboarding activity, call volume, follow-ups, and carrier information.

• Maintain accurate carrier contact information, operating preferences, and relevant details.

• Monitor existing carrier records and update information as needed.

• Ensure all onboarded carriers are properly documented and included in the appropriate tracking systems.

• Maintain organized daily activity logs and communication records.

• Coordinate with internal teams to address carrier-related inquiries or concerns.



Directory and Communication Management

• Maintain the GH Logistics carrier directory and designated group chats.

• Add new contacts and remove outdated or inactive members as needed.

• Ensure appropriate team members are included in required communication groups.

• Maintain accurate group membership and required administrative access.

• Escalate missing information, access restrictions, or communication issues to management.

• Keep carrier communication organized, professional, and accessible to internal teams.



What Success Looks Like

• Consistently completes 30 outbound calls daily.

• Handles approximately 20 inbound calls daily.

• Successfully onboards at least 3 qualified carriers daily.

• Creates at least 1 group chat daily with a newly onboarded carrier.

• Every onboarded carrier is properly verified through approved tools.

• No carriers on the DNU list are onboarded.

• All newly onboarded carriers are immediately posted in the communication channel.

• Carrier records, tracking spreadsheets, and directories remain accurate and updated.

• Builds and maintains reliable carrier relationships that support long-term network growth.

• Consistently meets daily activity and onboarding targets without sacrificing quality.

• Demonstrates urgency, accountability, and strong communication in a fast-paced freight environment.



Who We're Looking For

• Experience in Carrier Onboarding, Carrier Sales, Freight Brokerage, Dispatch, or U.S. Trucking Operations is preferred.

• Fluent English communication skills, both verbal and written.

• Comfortable making high volume outbound calls and handling inbound carrier inquiries.

• Familiarity with U.S. carrier verification, insurance, operating authority, and safety compliance.

• Experience with logistiics platforms is a strong advantage.

• Highly organized, tech-savvy, and comfortable managing multiple spreadsheets and communication channels.

• Strong attention to detail when reviewing carrier documentation and maintaining records.

• Proactive, persistent, and confident when communicating with trucking companies.

• Capable of building professional relationships and maintaining consistent carrier follow-ups.

• Thrives in a fast-paced, high-urgency freight environment.

• Performance-driven, KPI-oriented, and comfortable working with measurable daily targets.

• Follows instructions consistently and executes tasks with precision.

• Able to work independently while coordinating effectively with internal teams.

• Team-oriented, coachable, and open to feedback without ego.



Schedule and Work Setup

• Work Arrangement: Full-Time Remote | Direct Engagement with a US Company

• Available shift: Monday -  Friday 7 AM - 5 PM Central Time

• Active, attentive, and proactive Zoom participation with camera on is required throughout scheduled shifts.

• Time tracking software is used for accountability and performance monitoring.

What You'll Get

• Long-Term Opportunity: An ongoing leadership role within a growing US logistics company.

• Monthly Stipend: $75 monthly insurance stipend, with eligibility beginning after 30 days of engagement.

• Regular Payment Schedule: Payments processed twice monthly according to established payroll schedules.

• Direct US Operations Exposure: Work closely with US-based logistics teams and operational leadership.

• Meaningful Operational Impact: Help build a reliable carrier network, prevent freight fraud through proper verification, and strengthen GH Logistics' capacity to support consistent freight coverage.

• Structured Workflows: Established carrier onboarding procedures, clear daily KPIs, organized tracking systems, and opportunities to improve carrier relationships and network efficiency.



If you're someone who enjoys connecting with people, thrives in a high-volume calling environment, and takes pride in building reliable business relationships, we'd love to hear from you.



Apply Here: 



Note: After submission, our team will review your information and contact you if you meet the qualifications for the role. Candidates with direct experience in U.S. freight brokerage, carrier onboarding, or trucking operations will be prioritized.

title: Track & Trace – Quality Assurance Team Lead (Brokerage Operations)
description:
GH Logistics is a growing US-based freight brokerage and asset-based logistics company specializing in dry van and reefer freight. Our operations are built on strong systems, clear communication, accountability, and reliable execution.



We're looking for an experienced, detail-oriented, and results-driven Track & Trace Quality Assurance Team Lead to oversee our QA operations, lead a team of remote associates, and ensure every booked load is properly verified before pickup. This is a hands-on leadership position for someone with strong US freight brokerage experience, sound operational judgment, and the ability to hold a team accountable in a fast-paced environment.



If you have experience managing logistics operations, identifying freight fraud risks, resolving escalations, and driving team performance, we'd like to hear from you.



Role Overview

Every day, GH Logistics books trucks to move freight across the United States. Before those trucks pick up, our Quality Assurance team verifies that the assigned drivers are legitimate, qualified, properly documented, and prepared to execute their loads.



As the Quality Assurance Team Lead, you will be responsible for overseeing the team's daily workload, monitoring verification progress, reviewing operational accuracy, and ensuring that no critical verification steps are overlooked. You will serve as the primary point of escalation for unresolved driver verification issues, suspicious carrier activity, tracking discrepancies, and operational concerns that could affect pickup performance or shipment security.



Beyond supervising the team, you are expected to remain actively involved in operations, make timely decisions, identify process gaps, and ensure consistent execution of established SOPs. This is a working leadership role, not solely an administrative or supervisory position. You must be comfortable stepping into operational tasks, handling difficult situations, and taking ownership of your team's results.



What You'll Be Doing



Team Leadership & Daily Operations

title: Accounting Specialist (Remote, Part-Time to Full-Time, US Hours)
description:
About the Role

Are you a motivated, detail-oriented accounting professional who loves keeping numbers accurate and deadlines on track? We’re looking for an Accounting Specialist to manage the financial production for a portfolio of homeowners associations (HOAs) under a US-based community management company. This is a key operational role with hands-on exposure to bank reconciliations, AP/AR, and monthly financial reporting. If you’re organized, great at building working relationships, and looking for a long-term role where you can grow, this could be the right fit for you.



Key Responsibilities



Perform daily bank reconciliations

Support and manage accounts payable and accounts receivable processes

Set up and update homeowner accounts and transfers

Respond to basic billing and account questions from homeowners

Help prepare and produce monthly financial reports, making sure they’re accurate and delivered on time

Communicate with community managers, vendors, homeowners, and others to clarify requests, gather documents, and resolve issues

Provide general accounting support and guidance to Community Managers

Organize and submit basic tax forms under supervision, and coordinate with tax and audit professionals when needed

Collaborate with team members and outside partners such as auditors and banking professionals on special projects

Meet deadlines for all managed associations based on contractual delivery dates

Maintain accounts receivable files and records



Qualifications



Basic understanding of accounting principles and solid technical accounting skills

Strong proficiency in Google Workspace

Experience with Vantaca is highly preferred

Excellent organization skills, a sharp eye for detail, and the ability to spot irregularities

Proven ability to prioritize, handle workload changes, and consistently meet deadlines

Strong written and verbal communication skills

Positive, customer-friendly attitude and eagerness to help

Quick to learn new software and systems

High sense of accountability, able to work independently, and willing to learn and grow

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills



Preferred Qualifications



Currently enrolled in or completed a degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

3+ years of experience in US accounting or bookkeeping

Data management skills



Why Join Us



Fully remote role with flexibility

Part-time with the opportunity to transition to full-time

Long-term position with a supportive team that values collaboration and professional growth

Hands-on experience in HOA accounting, working alongside experienced professionals



How to Apply



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph and start your message with the phrase “You can count on me” so we know you read the full post. Applications without this phrase will not be entertained.



Your application should include:



1. Résumé (PDF)

Attach your résumé listing your accounting or bookkeeping roles, the US-based companies you supported, and the accounting software you used.



2. Video introduction (2–3 minutes)

Record a short video and include the link in your message (Loom, Google Drive, or YouTube unlisted). Make sure anyone with the link can view it. In the video, cover:



Who you are and your current or most recent role

Your experience with bank reconciliations, AP/AR, and monthly financial reporting for US clients

How you stay accurate and on schedule when handling multiple accounts

Why this role interests you



Please speak naturally and don’t read from a script. We want to hear how you communicate.



3. Written answers to these questions



How many years of US accounting or bookkeeping experience do you have, and have you worked with HOAs or property management companies?

Walk us through how you perform a bank reconciliation and what you do when something doesn’t match.

Have you used Vantaca or other accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks, AppFolio, Xero)? Which ones, and for how long?

How do you handle a homeowner who is confused or upset about their account balance?

Confirm your availability for part-time US business hours (and openness to full-time later).



Incomplete applications, including those missing the résumé, video link, or written answers, will not be considered.

title: Video Editor and Content Coordinator
description:
Video Editor and Content Coordinator (Full-Time, Remote)



Hours: Full-Time | 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST | Monday to Friday



About the Role

We are a dynamic and fast-growing company looking for a skilled, detail-oriented Video Editor and Content Coordinator to join our team.



Editing is the core of the role. You’ll take raw footage that has already been filmed and edit it to an established look, using AI tools where they help. The role also includes planning the content calendar so posting stays on schedule.



What You’ll Do

Video Editing

Edit short-form videos from raw footage stored in Dropbox, delivering tight, clean clips that match the brand’s established look

Cut out dead air, stray hand movement, and anything that breaks the flow of a clip

Add on-screen text, captions, and graphics in the brand style

Use AI editing tools to speed up cutting, captioning, and text placement on real footage (AI is used to edit, not to generate on-camera content)

Turn one piece of footage into several formats, such as reels, carousels, and montages



Content Calendar and Planning

Build a weekly and monthly content calendar showing what to film, edit, and post, with clear deadlines

Identify trending formats and suggest how to adapt them to the brand

Flag which filmed clips are ready to edit and which still need to be shot, with a short list of what to film next

Keep a running library of finished content and what has been posted



Delivery and Review

Upload finished files to a shared workspace and track the status of each video

Revise edits based on feedback and return corrections within agreed turnaround times

Track posting frequency and flag gaps early



Secondary Responsibilities

Support Meta ads by reviewing ad performance and suggesting changes

Support product sourcing for styled shoots, including source research and order tracking



What We’re Looking For

Proven experience editing short-form video for Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube, ideally for a creator, brand, or agency

Strong sense of pacing, tight cuts, and clean visual style, and able to work from raw footage with minimal direction

Hands-on experience using AI in an editing workflow, such as AI captioning, cut suggestions, or text generation, with good judgment about when to use it and when not to

Familiarity with CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar software

Strong visual taste for lifestyle, home, and product content, able to match an established look and spot when something is off

Comfortable building a content calendar and thinking ahead about what to film and post

Clear, warm, professional writing, and asks good questions early

Takes initiative, suggests ideas without being asked, and raises problems before they become deadlines

Keeps files, deadlines, and status organized and works through a plan without needing reminders

Meets deadlines consistently and communicates early when something will be late

Enjoys creative work, takes feedback well, and wants to grow with the business

Works independently within an agreed plan and checks in before changing it

Meta Ads Manager experience, including reading ad performance and recommending budget changes, is a nice to have

Experience sourcing products or coordinating styled shoots is a nice to have

Experience with a creator account in lifestyle, home, or product niches is a nice to have



What We Offer

Full-time, long-term role

Paid Time Off (PTO)

Paid U.S. holiday leaves

Medical stipend after 3 months

Opportunity to grow into expanded responsibility over time

Clear opportunities for growth and professional development

Collaborative, supportive, and people-first work environment

title: Real Estate VP Technology Strategy and Innovation
description:
Reports to CEO and President

Works closely with the VP of Technology Operations and Systems Integration and Lead Management team; Operations; Agent Services; Marketing; Compliance; Finance; and external technology partners



Position Overview

YLN is creating this role to own both technology direction and portfolio delivery for its next stage of growth. The VP will translate the 2027 growth plan into an executable roadmap for platforms, data, AI, automation, security, staffing, and

investment. The role is accountable for priorities, capacity decisions, delivery commitments, and measurable business

results across the technology portfolio.



Role Distinction

This role has final accountability for enterprise technology priorities and delivery outcomes. Within approved budgets and

executive direction, the VP sets the roadmap, target architecture, sequence, deadlines, and capacity requirements. Zohaib

directs the team's daily work and assigns resources to approved priorities. When demand exceeds capacity, Zohaib

presents the constraint and options; this VP d
 what moves, what pauses, and what staffing is needed, escalating

budget or headcount decisions to the CEO and President.



Core Responsibilities and Area Accountability

1. 2027 Growth Roadmap - Own a multi-year roadmap tied to growth and revenue goals, with named owners, deadlines, dependencies, capacity, and staffing assumptions. Review delivery performance regularly and make timely priority or resource decisions when commitments are at risk.

2. Scalable Technology Stack - Own target architecture across Zillow Pro, Follow Up Boss, Ylopo, eRelocation, Biloco, and future tools. Before approval, assess effects on other departments, existing workflows, reporting, permissions, costs, support, and the agent and client experience.

3. AI and Automation - Work with department leaders to identify high-burden manual processes and prioritize practical AI or automation. Define the baseline, expected benefit, controls, owner, and adoption plan; check back after launch to confirm the change solved the problem.

4. Data Quality and Analytics - Own data definitions, reporting requirements, executive dashboards, and reporting priorities. Set standards and accountability for accurate, timely reports; use results to guide routing, nurture, staffing, and investment decisions while Zohaib owns report production and delivery.

5. Agent and Client Growth - Design technology that strengthens onboarding, partner service, agent productivity, and retention. Involve affected teams before changes are made, plan training and support, and validate afterward that workflows and the agent or client experience improved.

6. Vendor Governance and Budget - Own platform selection, contracts, strategic vendor calls, technology budget, licensing

policy, service levels, security, and vendor risk. Maintain accountability for technology spend and billing controls; Zohaib manages support calls, usage records, and invoice validation.

7. Cross Functional Leadership - Set portfolio priorities and delivery standards, direct work through the approved roadmap,

and hold leaders accountable for commitments. Lead impact reviews with Operations, Agent Services, Marketing, Compliance, Finance, and other teams before and after material changes.



Qualifications

• Senior technology leadership experience in a growing, lead-driven organization, with accountability for strategy,

architecture, budgets, staffing, vendors, and delivery results.

• Demonstrated success with CRM, marketing technology, multi-client environments, and API-based integrations;

experience with Follow Up Boss, Zillow, Ylopo, or eRelocation is strongly preferred.

• Practical experience deploying AI and automation with baselines, controls, adoption plans, and measurable results.

• Strong command of data governance, reporting, analytics, cybersecurity, privacy, access management, and change

governance.

• Clear executive communication and the ability to resolve competing priorities, capacity constraints, and cross-functional

impacts.

• Real estate, relocation, mortgage, or agent-network experience is preferred. A bachelor's degree in technology,

business, or a related field, or equivalent experience, is expected.

Success Measures

• A prioritized 2027 roadmap is actively managed with owners, deadlines, capacity, staffing assumptions, and clear

escalation paths.

• Portfolio commitments are delivered predictably, and capacity conflicts are resolved through explicit reprioritization,

staffing, or executive decisions.

• At least one high-burden manual process is improved within 90 days, with a documented baseline and measurable

result.

• Affected departments confirm that material changes improve workflows, reporting, permissions, or the agent and client

experience.

• Executive and recurring reports have defined owners, standards, schedules, and reliable source data.

• Technology vendors, contracts, billing, licensing, security, and access risks are reviewed on schedule and acted upon.

description:
Full time / Part time

Schedule: Flexible, with some overlap with US Pacific Time business hours



About Us

We’re a Los Angeles real estate investment company managing a portfolio of 15+ residential properties, including multifamily and co-living buildings. All property management and accounting runs on AppFolio. We’re looking for a detail-oriented bookkeeper to own our books in AppFolio and help us automate as much of the process as possible. 



What You’ll Do

Import and upload bank transactions and statements into AppFolio for multiple properties and bank accounts

Complete monthly bank reconciliations for every property and account, on time, every month

Categorize income and expenses accurately (rent, deposits, repairs, utilities, mortgage, etc.)

Run monthly audits: flag discrepancies, duplicate entries, missing receipts, unapplied payments, and tenant ledger errors

Review AR (tenant balances, delinquencies) and AP (vendor bills, payments)

Prepare monthly reports: P&L by property, cash flow, rent roll, and owner statements

Set up and improve automations — bank feeds, recurring bills/charges, rules, and workflows (experience with AppFolio’s AI tools, including Realm-X, is a big plus)

Recommend ways to make our bookkeeping faster and cleaner

Requirements

Proven hands-on experience with AppFolio (required — please describe exactly what you’ve done in it)

2+ years of bookkeeping experience, ideally for real estate / property management

Strong understanding of bank reconciliation, accrual vs. cash accounting, and security deposit accounting

Comfortable with automation tools (bank feeds, rules, Zapier, Excel/Google Sheets formulas, or similar)

Excellent attention to detail and ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Clear written English communication

Reliable internet and a backup power/internet plan

Nice to Have

Accounting degree or bookkeeping certification

Experience managing books for multiple entities/LLCs



How to Apply

Send an
 with the subject line “AppFolio Bookkeeper – [Your Name]” and include:

Your resume

A short description of your AppFolio experience — which features you’ve used and how many properties/units you’ve managed

One example of a process you automated and the time it saved

Your available hours

title: Database Analyst – Solar Operations
description:
Summary

SpartanX is seeking a detail-oriented, analytical Database Analyst to support data management, reporting, and operational performance across our growing residential solar organization. This position plays an important role in maintaining accurate data, identifying discrepancies, developing meaningful reports, and helping operational leaders make informed decisions. We're looking for someone who understands databases, enjoys solving problems, and can turn complex information into clear, actionable insights. The ideal candidate combines strong technical skills with an understanding of business operations and takes ownership of data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.



What You'll Do

Database Management & Data Integrity

- Monitor, review, and maintain the accuracy and consistency of operational data across company systems.

- Identify and resolve duplicate, missing, incomplete, or inconsistent records.

- Perform routine data validation, reconciliation, and quality-control checks.

- Support data organization, standardization, and documentation.

- Investigate discrepancies between databases, CRM platforms, and operational reporting systems.

- Assist with data imports, exports, updates, and system integrations as needed.



Reporting & Data Analysis

- Develop and maintain operational reports, dashboards, and performance tracking tools.

- Analyze data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.

- Track key performance indicators across departments, including project timelines, productivity, and operational performance.

- Prepare recurring and ad hoc reports for management and leadership.

- Translate complex data into clear summaries and actionable recommendations.

- Support accurate reporting across Installation, Permitting, Inspections, Service, and other operational teams.



Process Improvement & Collaboration

- Work with department leaders to understand reporting requirements and data challenges.

- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive reporting and data-management tasks.

- Assist with improving data collection, entry standards, and reporting workflows.

- Troubleshoot data-related issues and coordinate resolutions with appropriate teams.

- Maintain documentation for reports, data definitions, and standard operating procedures.

- Support projects involving database improvements, reporting enhancements, and system optimization.



What We're Looking For

- Previous experience as a Database Analyst, Data Analyst, Reporting Analyst, or similar position.

- Strong understanding of database structures, data management, and data integrity.

- Proficiency in SQL, including writing queries, filtering data, joining tables, and validating results.

- Advanced Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and data analysis.

- Experience developing reports and analyzing large datasets.

- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.

- Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

- Ability to manage multiple reporting requests and meet deadlines.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Ability to work independently in a remote environment and collaborate with U.S.-based teams.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio, or similar reporting platforms.

- Familiarity with CRM systems, operational databases, and business intelligence tools.

- Experience with data cleaning, transformation, and reporting automation.

- Knowledge of Python or other data analysis tools.

- Experience supporting operations, construction, renewable energy, or residential solar organizations.

- Familiarity with data integration processes and API-based reporting.

- Experience creating standardized dashboards and KPI reporting frameworks.



Schedule & Work Arrangement

Full-Time | Remote – Offshore

Must be available to work during designated U.S. business hours.



What SpartanX Provides

- Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.

- Opportunity to support data-driven decision-making across a growing residential solar company.

- Professional development and advancement opportunities.

- Collaborative environment with exposure to multiple operational departments.

- Opportunity to contribute directly to reporting improvements, system efficiency, and operational performance.



Why SpartanX?

At SpartanX, accurate information is essential to delivering efficient, high-quality residential solar operations. Our Database Analyst will help ensure leadership has reliable information to evaluate performance, identify challenges, and make better decisions. We're looking for someone who doesn't just report numbers but understands what those numbers mean—and knows when something doesn't add up.



If you're analytical, resourceful, and ready to make a measurable impact, we want to hear from you!



Apply Here: 



Solar Done Right.

title: Operations Assistant VA
description:
Keep Every Order Moving, From Vendor to Warehouse



WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS



Before a lab can order from Filtrous, the product has to be on our shelves, and that starts with a purchase order placed well in advance. When that order goes out late, a vendor falls behind, or a shipment arrives wrong, our stock runs low and customers wait. As our Operations Assistant VA, you'll own the purchasing and vendor pipeline end-to-end, from the reorder sheet to the warehouse door. You'll make sure purchase orders go out on time, vendors stay on schedule, and shipments don't fall apart. In a business built on speed and reliability, your work keeps products in stock and our customers' labs running.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Turn the Reorder Sheet into Purchase Orders: Work from our reorder sheet to figure out what we need, build purchase orders in our ERP system with the purchasing team, and route them to leadership for approval.



• Source Product with Vendors: Find supplier options, request and compare quotes, and work through product specs and minimum order quantities before an order is placed.



• Confirm Every Order Detail: Send purchase orders to vendors, get the proforma invoice back, and work out adjustments like carton quantities and price changes. Verify barcodes with our operations team before anything is confirmed, and send vendors the full item package: photos, Certificate of Analysis (CoA), and packing list.



• Keep Payments and Production on Track: Send vendor invoices to our finance team for payment, share proof of payment with the vendor, and get a production timeline back. Follow up with every vendor at least weekly, every three days if they go quiet, and escalate if they stop responding. WeChat must be used during business hours for faster turnaround on vendor communication.



• Coordinate Shipping, Tariffs, and Customs: Work with our logistics team and freight partners on shipping and tariffs, consolidating across open purchase orders so we never ship a partial container. Handle customs declarations, declared values, and product classifications using information provided or approved by the company.



• Keep the Warehouse Ready for Every Delivery: Update our ERP system as soon as a delivery date is set and share it with the warehouse right away, then send reminders a week out, three days out, and the morning of delivery.



• Fix Problems and Track Every Order: If a shipment arrives incorrect or damaged, contact the vendor promptly and arrange a timely re-shipment at the vendor's cost. Keep a tracking sheet with each PO number, its exact status, and dates for everything, and other duties as assigned.



PROBLEMS YOU WILL SOLVE



• Purchase orders go out late: Without one person working the reorder sheet and pushing orders through approval, purchase orders slip and stock runs low before replacements are on the way.



• Vendors drift off schedule: When no one follows up on a steady rhythm, suppliers go quiet, production timelines slide, and delays surface only when it is too late to recover.



• Order details slip through the cracks: When carton quantities, price changes, barcodes, and product documents are not checked before an order is confirmed, small mistakes turn into wrong labels, wrong quantities, and costly rework.



• Shipping costs more than it should: Partial containers, orders that are not consolidated, and incomplete customs paperwork add freight costs, tariff surprises, and delays at the border.



• Deliveries catch the warehouse off guard: Without accurate delivery dates and timely reminders, shipments show up unannounced, receiving gets rushed, and damaged or incorrect goods are not sent back to the vendor in time.



HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED



• Get purchase orders built, approved, and sent to vendors on time, every month

• Follow up on every open order at least weekly, with a confirmed production timeline

• Ship zero partial containers by consolidating open orders on every shipment

• Keep the tracking sheet and ERP current, and give the warehouse notice before every delivery



WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT HERE



At Filtrous, you won't be a back-office clerk pushing paperwork. You'll own a pipeline that keeps real laboratories stocked with the supplies they rely on every day. You'll work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where your ideas for faster, smoother purchasing actually get implemented. You'll collaborate closely with our purchasing, finance, logistics, and warehouse teams, and your impact on on-time orders and in-stock products will be visible and celebrated. As we grow, so will your career, with opportunities to shape how Filtrous buys and ships from the ground up.



WHO YOU ARE



• Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Operations, or a related field (required)

• Experience in purchasing, procurement, or supply chain coordination, working directly with vendors (required)

• Proficient with ERP and inventory systems (e.g., Acumatica, NetSuite, SAP) and spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets)

• Comfortable with international shipping basics: freight, tariffs, customs declarations, and product classifications

• Strong written English and the persistence to keep vendors responsive across time zones

• Highly organized with a process-driven mindset and commitment to follow-through



Bonus points if you have:

• Background in the life sciences, biotechnology, or laboratory supplies industry

• Experience importing from overseas suppliers, including container consolidation and vendor communication on WeChat



ABOUT FILTROUS



Founded in 2017, Filtrous delivers speed, quality, and value to agile labs. We're a lab supplies distributor serving laboratories across a wide range of scientific and industrial sectors. Our secret? We combine uncompromising product quality with customer service that actually picks up the phone.



POSITION DETAILS



Compensation: $4.00 – $6.00 USD per hour

Job Type: Part-time (20 hours per week)

Location: Remote

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 3:00–7:00 PM Pacific Time (7:00–11:00 AM Philippine Time, Tuesday to Saturday)



READY TO JOIN US?



If you love keeping complex orders on track, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help shape how a growing company buys and ships, we'd love to hear from you.

description:

/careers/apply



About the Company:

BrokerVA is a specialized virtual assistant and operations support company dedicated exclusively to the mortgage industry. Designed to help mortgage brokers and lenders scale efficiently, the company provides trained, experienced mortgage professionals who integrate seamlessly into existing operations.



About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Loan Officer Assistant (LOA) / Junior Mortgage Processor with hands-on experience in the U.S. mortgage industry. The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of borrower financial analysis, loan program eligibility, and the initial stages of the mortgage origination and processing workflow.



This role requires someone who can independently review loan applications, identify potential red flags, determine documentation needs, and prepare files for submission to underwriting. Experience working with wholesale lenders and broker-side mortgage operations is highly preferred.



Key Responsibilities

- Income Calculation and Analysis: Calculate and analyze borrower income, with a strong emphasis on self-employed borrowers, including reviewing tax returns, profit and loss statements, and other supporting financial documents.

- Borrower Financial Review: Evaluate credit reports, assets, liabilities, and income documentation to assess borrower qualifications and identify suitable loan programs.

- Loan Program Analysis: Identify potential loan options based on borrower qualifications, including Conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, and Non-QM, as applicable.

- Initial File Review: Identify red flags, discrepancies, missing information, and potential qualification issues during the initial review.

- Needs List Preparation: Request additional documentation and prepare clear, comprehensive needs lists to address outstanding items before submission.

- Loan Registration: Register loan files through various wholesale lender portals, such as UWM, Rocket Mortgage, PennyMac, TPO, Newrez, and other investors.

- Pricing and Initial Disclosures: Understand mortgage pricing and assist with preparing the initial Loan Estimate (LE) for disclosure, following applicable procedures and compliance requirements.

- Automated Underwriting System (AUS): Run and review AUS findings, identify eligibility issues or warnings, and help resolve findings by addressing documentation gaps or other concerns.

- Document Management: Upload, organize, and index loan documents in the appropriate loan origination system (LOS) and lender portals.

- Third-Party Orders: Order and track third-party services and documentation, such as title, appraisal, homeowners insurance, and other required reports.

- Document Review and Condition Preparation: Review documents received from borrowers and third parties to determine whether they adequately address anticipated underwriting requirements.

- Underwriting Submission: Prepare complete and properly documented loan files and submit them to underwriting through the appropriate lender portal.



Qualifications and Requirements

- At least 2 year of hands-on experience in U.S. mortgage origination, preferably in an LOA, Junior Processor, Loan Setup, or Mortgage Processing role.

- Strong knowledge of U.S. mortgage documentation and the loan origination process.

- Demonstrated experience calculating and analyzing income, especially for self-employed borrowers.

- Familiarity with borrower qualification guidelines and major mortgage loan programs.

- Experience registering loans through wholesale lender portals, preferably UWM, Rocket Mortgage, PennyMac, TPO, and Newrez.

- Working knowledge of mortgage pricing, initial Loan Estimates, and disclosure procedures.

- Experience running and interpreting AUS findings, such as DU and LPA.

- Familiarity with document uploading, indexing, third-party orders, and underwriting submission requirements.

- Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, U.S.-based mortgage environment.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working on the broker/wholesale lending side, particularly with non-delegated lenders.

- Familiarity with mortgage LOS platforms such as Encompass, LendingPad, Arive, or similar systems.

- Experience reviewing complex self-employed income documentation and resolving initial loan qualification issues.

- Ability to manage files with minimal supervision and prepare them for underwriting without extensive training.



What We’re Looking For

We need someone who understands more than basic administrative support. The ideal candidate should be comfortable reviewing borrower financials, calculating income, evaluating loan eligibility, identifying potential issues, and preparing mortgage files for underwriting.



Candidates must have relevant, hands-on U.S. mortgage experience and be ready to apply their knowledge with minimal supervision.

description:

Full-Time · Long-Term · Above-Market Pay for the Right Person





ABOUT US



We run 2 fast-growing e-commerce brands for natural health products. Our customers are in Germany, Austria and Switzerland, and right now we are scaling hard into Black Friday and December.



We are building a lean, high-quality support setup: our AI drafts every reply, and one experienced specialist makes sure every answer that goes out is right. We are looking for that ONE person, long-term.

- Clear processes and a support tool we built ourselves



- Room to grow with the brands

Applications without the code word or without a WhatsApp number will not be considered.

title: Healthcare Technical Support
description:
• Pay: USD 950 a month base, plus performance incentives. Our top performers take home about USD 1,100 to 1,200 a month.

• Shift: Monday to Friday, US Eastern daytime in staggered shifts between 8 AM and 8 PM, with some weekend shifts and on-call turns (a night shift in Manila)

• Benefits: HMO from your third month, flexible paid time off

• Where: fully remote



A CALL, FOR EXAMPLE

An 81-year-old patient calls ten minutes before his video visit. His tablet screen is dark and he is not sure it is charged. You stay calm, find out what he sees, get the tablet charging and on Wi-Fi, and get him into the visit before his nurse gives up waiting.



THE JOB

Our patients are mostly older adults at home in the US with heart failure or COPD. They see their care team by video on a tablet we send them, and their pulse oximeter and blood pressure monitor send readings to us. When something stops working, you are the person who fixes it, often by walking a patient who is not comfortable with technology through it one step at a time.



You take about 50 calls a day from patients and clinicians: a tablet that will not join a visit, a device that stopped sending readings, a clinician who needs help in Athenahealth. You own each problem until it is solved, and you write clear reports for our engineers when something needs a fix on their side.



WHAT YOU NEED



• 2 or more years in technical or customer support where you solved technology problems for customers

• Tech savviness: you pick up new devices and tools quickly (Android tablets, Zoom, Google Workspace)

• A friendly, patient way of helping older adults in the US, in clear English

• Reliable high-speed internet and availability for this shift for the long term

Experience with Samsung Knox or another device-management tool, remote monitoring devices, Athenahealth, or an issue tracker such as GitLab is a plus.



HOW TO APPLY (ABOUT 15 MINUTES)



1. Apply only at https://www.ansiblehealth.com/careers/jobs/telehealth-technical-support-357d36ee/apply?ref=xrfqfkc6 . Applications sent any other way are not reviewed.

2. Answer a few quick questions, including one troubleshooting scenario. When the form asks for the word from this posting, type TABLET.

3. Record your voice on the form: read three lines from a real support call, then talk a patient through joining his visit (about five minutes).

4. Give your earliest start date and the notice you owe your current employer.

If you are shortlisted, we email you a link to book a 15-minute call with our recruiter.

title: Financial Operations & Executive Support Specialist
description:
Work Type: Remote 

Schedule: Full-Time Preferred  

Location: Philippines  

Salary: $1,200–$1,800 USD/month depending on experience



About the Role



StorHouse Management Co. is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Financial Operations & Executive Support Specialist to support our bookkeeping, financial reporting, client operations, and executive administration.



This is not a basic virtual assistant role.



We are looking for someone comfortable working in QuickBooks Online, who understands bookkeeping and reconciliations, can update cash flow reports and financial trackers, and can provide strong executive and administrative support.



You should be proactive, accurate, dependable, and comfortable working with confidential financial information.



Responsibilities



Bookkeeping & Financial Operations



- Perform bookkeeping for assigned client entities in QuickBooks Online

- Categorize transactions

- Reconcile bank and credit card accounts

- Review uncategorized and unusual transactions

- Maintain accurate general ledgers

- Assist with month-end bookkeeping close

- Update cash flow statements and cash flow forecasts

- Maintain financial dashboards and reporting spreadsheets

- Review accounts payable and accounts receivable

- Help keep client books current and organized

- Identify discrepancies or missing information and flag them for review



Invoicing & Accounts Receivable



- Prepare and send client invoices

- Maintain recurring billing schedules

- Track unpaid invoices

- Follow up on outstanding balances

- Maintain payment records

- Flag billing discrepancies



Master Sheets & Trackers



Maintain and update company-wide master spreadsheets, including:



- Master client and entity list

- Cash flow trackers

- Accounts payable tracker

- Accounts receivable tracker

- W-9 / 1099 tracker

- Deal and contract tracker

- Client onboarding and migration tracker

- Recurring deadline tracker

- Open items and follow-up tracker



Client & Entity Administration



- Maintain client and entity records in Canopy

- Organize and upload client documents

- Assist with client onboarding

- Help maintain client portals

- Track outstanding information and documents

- Help manage annual LLC and corporate registration deadlines

- Track POA and recurring compliance items

- Assist with monthly transcript-related workflows

- Follow up on missing W-9s and supporting documents



Ramp & Expense Management



- Categorize transactions in Ramp

- Match receipts to transactions

- Follow up on missing receipts

- Maintain missing-receipt lists

- Flag unusual or questionable transactions



Executive Assistant Support



- Maintain priority lists and follow-up items

- Assist with calendar and meeting coordination

- Prepare spreadsheets, reports, and meeting materials

- Draft routine client and vendor communications

- Follow up with clients, team members, vendors, and outside professionals

- Help ensure deadlines and outstanding items do not fall through the cracks

- Maintain organized electronic files

- Handle confidential information with discretion



Client Contracts



- Draft client service agreements using our existing templates

- Update agreements using the scope and pricing provided by management

- Confirm legal entity names, services, and fees

- Track contracts from draft through signature

- Save executed agreements in the correct client record

- Flag unusual contract terms for review



You will not independently set pricing, negotiate legal terms, or bind the company.



Required Skills



- Strong QuickBooks Online experience

- Hands-on bookkeeping experience

- Bank and credit card reconciliation experience

- Understanding of basic financial statements

- Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills

- Strong attention to detail

- Excellent organizational skills

- Strong written English

- Ability to manage multiple clients, deadlines, and projects

- Ability to work independently

- Strong follow-through

- Comfortable handling confidential financial information



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



- Canopy

- Ramp

- Gusto

- Rippling

- Google Workspace

- Accounting firms

- CFO or business management firms

- Executive assistant work

- Cash flow forecasting

- Client financial reporting



Who Will Do Well in This Role



You will be a strong fit if:



- You notice when numbers do not look right

- You enjoy keeping financial records organized

- You follow through without repeated reminders

- You are comfortable asking questions instead of guessing

- You can manage multiple responsibilities without losing track of details

- You enjoy both finance/accounting work and executive support

- You understand that a strong back office is essential to running a successful company



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short introduction

2. Your QuickBooks Online experience

3. Your bookkeeping experience

4. Your experience with bank reconciliations and financial reporting

5. Your experience with Google Sheets or Excel

6. Any experience with Canopy, Ramp, Gusto, or similar systems

7. Your current monthly salary expectation in USD

8. Your available work hours and time zone

9. Your internet speed

10. The word **STORHOUSE** at the top of your application so we know you read the full job post



Please also describe one example of a bookkeeping or financial issue you identified and how you handled it.

title: Customer Support Manager (US Payroll, HR & Benefits Support Team)
description:
Customer Support Manager | Remote | Full Time

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time

(8:00 PM to 5:00 AM Philippine time; 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM from November to March)



People who call our support line usually need a clear answer about something that matters to them: a paycheck, a benefit, a deadline, or an HR question. We're looking for a manager who gets that and can lead a team that answers with accuracy, urgency, and care.



ABOUT COLLABPEO

collabPEO is a US-based PEO (Professional Employer Organization). We handle payroll, employee benefits, HR support, compliance, and risk management for businesses, so they can focus on running their company.



THE ROLE

You'll lead a remote support team of about 10 to 20 people who answer questions from our clients (business owners and managers) and their employees. This is a people-leadership and operations role. You'll stay close enough to the calls to spot recurring issues, but your main job is building a strong team, keeping the queue covered, setting clear expectations, and improving the service experience.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead, coach, and develop a remote support team of 10 to 20 people

- Own daily operations: staffing, scheduling, and queue coverage for the full 8 AM to 5 PM ET window

- Set performance targets and track call quality, response time, resolution, CSAT, abandonment, and schedule adherence

- Run one-on-ones, team huddles, call reviews, and coaching sessions with direct, useful feedback

- Recognize strong performance early and handle performance or attendance issues fairly and consistently

- Build and improve SOPs, workflows, knowledge base articles, and escalation paths so the team can answer correctly without unnecessary transfers

- Work with our HR, payroll, benefits, and compliance specialists to fix recurring issues and keep the team updated

- Review call data and customer feedback, spot patterns, and bring clear recommendations to leadership

- Help with hiring, onboarding, and training as the team grows

- Make sure the team handles sensitive payroll and personal information with strict confidentiality



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- At least 5 years of call center, contact center, or BPO experience

- At least 2 to 3 years as a Team Leader, Supervisor, or Manager handling 10 or more agents

- A track record of improving team KPIs and customer experience through coaching and clear processes

- Excellent spoken and written English, comfortable with US clients and US business culture

- Comfortable using call center data, QA scores, and customer feedback to make decisions

- Hands-on experience with call center, CRM, ticketing, or workforce management tools

- Organized, dependable, and calm under pressure when volume spikes or questions get complicated



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience in a US PEO, payroll, HR services, or employee benefits account

- Experience supporting both business clients and their employees

- Experience managing a fully remote team



WORK SETUP REQUIREMENTS

- Quiet, dedicated workspace suitable for calls and meetings

- Reliable primary internet (at least 25 Mbps) plus a backup connection

- Backup power (UPS or generator) for brownouts

- Noise-canceling headset and a computer that can handle calling and CRM tools at the same time



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Clients and their employees see our support line as dependable, and the team finds it well run. Your agents know what's expected, get regular coaching, have the information they need to answer accurately, and know when to bring in a specialist. Leadership has a clear view of performance, recurring issues, and where service can improve.



HOW TO APPLY

Applications that skip any step below won't be reviewed.

1. Use this subject line: CSM2026 - [Your Full Name]

2. Attach your resume

3. Answer these two questions in your message:

   a. What was the largest team you managed, and which KPIs were you directly responsible for?

   b. Tell us about an agent whose performance you turned around. What did you do?

4. Include a 1 to 2 minute voice recording (link or file) introducing yourself and describing how you run a team huddle

title: Senior Webflow & Shopify Developer (Part-Time, Long-Term)
description:
IMPORTANT: We are NOT hiring beginners. This is not an entry-level or learning role. You need 5+ years of professional web development experience and live projects in both Webflow and Shopify. If that isn’t you, please do not apply.



Pay: $10–$15 per hour, depending on experience



About Us

PM Furniture Assembly is a U.S.-based installation company serving homeowners and major product brands across the country. We install saunas, pergolas, gazebos, sheds, playsets and similar products. We’re rebuilding our website to support hundreds of product, brand and city pages, and we need a strong developer to lead the build.



The Project

Our website runs on Webflow today, and an agency will migrate it to Shopify. Once it’s live, we need someone to build out and maintain a very large library of pages and to make sure it’s all structured to scale.



We don’t have web development expertise in-house, and that’s why we’re hiring you. We’ll bring the business goals and the content. You make the decisions about how it’s built: architecture, templates, CMS structure, SEO and page performance. We also want your opinion when you see a better way.

Design reusable templates and CMS structures that make adding hundreds of pages fast and consistent

Build pages from scratch with strong design and conversion sense

Review the agency’s work on the new Shopify site and flag problems

Build SEO and AI search optimization into every page from the start

Keep the site fast, mobile-first and clean



What We’re Looking For



5+ years of web development experience, with deep, proven experience in both Webflow and Shopify. You’re an expert in both, not someone who has touched one.

Strong HTML, CSS and some JavaScript

Webflow CMS and reusable components, with a clean class naming approach (Client-First or similar)

Shopify Liquid, sections and theme customization

You take ownership and make decisions without being told what to do

Clear written and spoken English

Reliable internet and a computer

SEO and AEO (AI search) experience, including structured data

Product configurators, custom forms or quote flows

Webflow-to-Shopify migration experience

GitHub or version control



Schedule



Part-time, 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday

9:00 AM to 1:00 PM Eastern Time (10:00 PM to 2:00 AM in the Philippines during winter, 9:00 PM to 1:00 AM in summer)

Part-time to start, with a path to full-time

Start your message with the word “Pergola”

what you took from reading this job description and how you think you could help us

something about our website that caught your attention
