title: U.S. Small Business Bookkeeper Catch up & Clean Up Specialist
description:
JOB TYPE: Full-time



SALARY RANGE: $1,600 - 2,000/month depending on experience and ability.



LOCATION: Remote



JOB DESCRIPTION:



We are growing!! We have added 40 clients this year alone!



We're a US-based bookkeeping practice serving service based business, construction, e-commerce and retail clients, and we're looking for a senior bookkeeper who already understands the part of this work that trips most people up doing complex catchups and cleanups and onboarding new clients. We add between 6 and 12 new clients per month.



This is not a data-entry role. You'll own client books independently and review work done by others, so you need to genuinely understand all the theory and application behind the balance sheet and profit and loss.





What you'll do:



Own onboarding, catchup and cleanup for new clients behind the scenes using QuickBooks Online — categorization, reconciliation, and clean financials. Our U.S. team handles client communication and you will handle the financials.



Reconcile platform payouts to bank deposits, correctly separating gross sales, processing fees, refunds, and sales tax rather than booking the net deposit as revenue.



Set up and maintain clearing accounts so sales, fees, and payouts flow correctly.



Handle platform financing (e.g., Square Loans / Capital, Shopify Capital, PayPal Working Capital): book the funding as a liability, split repayments into principal vs. fee, and reconcile the liability against the platform's own loan/balance report each month.



Account for cash sales, owner draws, and tender-type differences.



Required:



3+ years of either service based and/or ecommerce bookkeeping, with strong QuickBooks Online expertise.

Hands-on experience reconciling at least two of these: Square, Shopify, Stripe, Amazon, PayPal, Etsy.

A real understanding of the payout-vs-sales gap and how to use a platform's reports to explain it.

Strong written English and reliable overlap with US business hours (some hours between 9am–5pm Pacific Time).

Accuracy, discretion with financial data, and the ability to work independently.



Must be willing to work California business hours 8am to 5pm. 



Nice to have:



Experience across several of the platforms above.

Familiarity with platform financing products and how their repayments are reported.

QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification.

No competition - in 90% of the markets we serve, we have no competitors. Because of this, our sale is pretty easy to make.





Compensation and Benefits

Competitive compensation package - $5 per hour



Benefits to be provided after completion of three months:

Health Insurance



Benefits to be provided after completion of one year:

Paid Two weeks off for Christmas Season



Type of Employment

Full Time

40 hours per week





Entry Level Details

Note that this is an entry-level job. 

We do NOT expect you to have any prior sales experience. 

If you’re looking to switch careers and get your foot in the door, this could be great for you. 

We will train you on how to take customers through the sales process. 

This is a great opportunity for anyone with a background in any of the following areas: Customer Service, Nursing, Nurse Practitioners, Hotel and Hospitality, Front Desk, Secretary, Retail, Receptionist, Recruiting, Teachers and anyone with teaching experience, Tutoring, Inbound Representative, Inbound Sales, Outbound Caller, Appointment Setting, Cold and warm calling, Lead qualification





Duties and Responsibilities

Sell Stick Shift Driving Lessons

Inbound Call Handling - Answer phones and talk to prospects through the sale or sign up

Outbound Follow-Up - Call, text, and
 to get the prospect to the finish line

Qualify Prospects - Make sure their needs fit our model

Secret Message: When you apply, under the section that says "Is there anything else you'd like to write or include?", write the word PINK ELEPHANT. This will show us that you read the entire job description.

Outbound Dialing - Dialing prospective customers and leaving voi
s.

Text Message and
 Handling - Quickly handle inbound text messages and
s that are sent to the salesperson.

Paperwork Follow-Up - Follow up with prospective customers who have not yet signed up to make sure they got the paperwork. Handle any issues they had with doing the paperwork.

Review Solicitation - Follow up with customers after the lesson to request a review on Google and Yelp

Edit customer records in our CRM (HubSpot)





Qualifications

At least three years of work experience, preferably interacting with people. 

Must have your own computer, reliable high-speed internet, and good quality headset and microphone.

English Grammar and Language: You must be fluent in English

Strong Problem-Solving skills

Customer Service Oriented and ability to adapt/respond properly to different types of scenarios

Ability to Multitask, prioritize and manage time effectively





What's Hard About This Job

Working Remotely - We're a remote-first company, and we never want to have an office. This is great if you like working by yourself in the quiet, but it can be terribly painful if you need the energy of coworkers nearby.

Our Cultural Values - We're an American company with an incredibly unusual culture. Even by American standards, our 7 cultural values are highly unusual. Our culture is challenging for people accustomed to corporate culture and especially difficult for people who grew up in Confucian cultures. It's a great culture for people who speak directly and have a great deal of self-confidence and ownership. If you identify as a misfit, you'll do well.

Multiple Software Systems - You're going to need to learn how to use 12 different software systems. This is great if you want to get exposed to and experienced with lots of technology, but it can be tough if you have a hard time learning technology. Secret Message - When you apply, you'll see a box that asks if you want to add anything else. Type in PINK ELEPHANT in all capital letters exactly as we've shown it here. 





Cheat Code for getting a job with us:

1) Our application comprises the majority of our recruiting process. Because of that, we suggest that you give us thoughtful responses and rich stories. We typically only interview applicants who give rich and detailed answers to our questions. If you write short responses so that you can hurry up and finish the application, you will not get interviewed. 

2) Tell us stories about how your actions match your beliefs and values. For example, if I say I value health and fitness, you don't know if I'm telling you the truth or if I'm just telling you what sounds good. But, if I tell you things I've done, I can illustrate my values of health and fitness with proof. For example, I go to the gym 4 days per week, I've done 6 triathlons, including an Ironman, and I can swim 3000 meters in one hour. My examples of things I've done prove that my actions match my values system. 

3) Be vulnerable and honest. We take very detailed notes during the interview process, and we conduct extensive background checks. If the stories you tell about yourself don't match what your references say, we will not hire you. We'd rather hire a C student who is honest about being a C student than someone who is a C student but tries to pass themselves off as an A student. Remember, this is an entry-level job. We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for an excellent cultural fit.

title: Operations Manager / Head of Operations — E-commerce
description:
Operations Manager / Head of Operations — E-commerce



Remote · Full-time · Long-term · Potential to grow into COO



A little about us

We're Kandrix, a growing direct-response e-commerce company, primarily operating in the health, wellness and beauty space.

We've been building our business for over 2 years, working across multiple international markets with a remote team.

We're a small, ambitious team with high standards. We value ownership, curiosity, open communication and people who genuinely care about what they're building.



And right now, there's one important person missing from our team:

A strong operational leader who can take ownership of our operations, develop our teams and help us build a more efficient, profitable and scalable business.



The role

As Head of Operations, you'll gradually take ownership of Kandrix's day-to-day operations and become the main connection between the founders and our teams.

We want someone who understands how the entire business works, keeps a clear overview, recognizes problems and opportunities, and actively drives improvements.

Not someone who simply manages what's already there, but someone who helps us build something better.



What you'll be responsible for



Leadership & Team Performance

Lead department managers, motivate teams and build a culture of ownership, accountability and results.

Build strong personal connections with team members through regular conversations, listening to their feedback, recognizing their progress and inspiring them to grow.

Set clear expectations, develop people and ensure the right people are in the right positions.



KPIs & Business Performance

Establish meaningful KPIs and targets across departments.

Monitor performance, investigate problems and turn insights into actions that improve business results.



Structure & Systems

Build and optimize workflows, SOPs and operational systems, including Asana and Google Sheets.

Create clear priorities, responsibilities and accountability while eliminating unnecessary complexity.



Improvements, AI & Automation

Proactively identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies and opportunities.

Use AI, automation and smarter processes to make the business more efficient and scalable.

Take ownership of turning ideas into actual improvements.



Operational Oversight & Scalability

Maintain a clear overview of operations, priorities, team capacity and performance.

Anticipate what the business needs, coordinate initiatives and build the structures or teams needed to support growth.



Who we're looking for

Ideally, you have experience leading operations and teams in a growing online business. Direct-response e-commerce experience is a big plus.

But experience alone isn't enough. The person behind the experience matters just as much to us.



We're looking for someone who:

- Is a strong leader: Motivates people, sets high standards and holds teams accountable.



- Takes real ownership: Doesn't wait for instructions, but investigates, d
 and takes action.



- Is curious and proactive: Asks questions, seeks context and constantly looks for improvements.



- Isn't a yes-person: Challenges ideas, speaks up and brings better solutions.



- Is structured and analytical: Understands data, creates clarity and solves problems at their root.



- Is business-minded and results-driven: Understands that everything we do should ultimately contribute to profitability and growth.



- Is AI-oriented: Recognizes opportunities to simplify, automate and scale operations.



- Is energetic and communicative: Brings positive energy, takes initiative and communicates clearly.



Ultimately, we're looking for someone who doesn't just keep Kandrix running, but genuinely enjoys making the business better every day.



What success looks like

Over time, we want you to become someone who understands Kandrix's operations inside out.

Someone who knows what's happening, what's working, what's holding us back and what we should improve next.

Our goal is to have independently performing teams, clear KPIs, efficient systems and a culture where people continuously improve and take ownership.

This allows the founders to focus on strategy and growth, while you take the lead on operations.

For the right person, this role has the potential to grow into a COO position.



What you can expect from us

- A small, ambitious international team with open communication.

- Direct collaboration with the founders.

- Freedom to bring ideas, challenge decisions and implement improvements.

- Real responsibility and room to grow.

- A long-term opportunity to become a key leader in our business.



We have high standards, but we're also human. We want people to enjoy their work, be themselves and genuinely grow together with the company.



Compensation

Compensation will depend on your experience, previous results and the value you can bring to the business.

For the right person, there's also the potential to grow into a profit-sharing arrangement over time, once you've become fully integrated into the business, taken real ownership and consistently demonstrated strong results.



Interested?

We'd genuinely love to hear from you!

And please, don't just send us your CV. We'd love to get to know the person behind the experience!



Please record a short LOOM video (3–5 minutes) telling us a little about yourself and covering the following:



Your experience & results: What teams or businesses have you managed, and what's an operational improvement you're genuinely proud of?



Your approach: How would you approach your first 30–60 days in a growing e-commerce business like ours?



Your perspective: What do you believe separates an average Operations Manager from a truly great one?



AI & systems: How have you used AI, automation or systems to improve business operations?



We're not looking for perfect answers or a polished presentation. We want to understand your experience, how you think, and who you are as a person.



Just be yourself!

Looking forward to hearing from you!

NO AI IS ALLOWED!!! HAVE TO HAVE SPORTS EXAMPLES



Who we are

Newton Creative is a sports-focused creative agency based in Knoxville, Tennessee, USA. We create content for high school and college athletic programs, from Friday night football to state championship events. Our footage is full of big hits, buzzer-beaters, sideline energy and moments athletes remember for the rest of their lives. We need an editor who can turn it into reels that stop the scroll.



What you’ll do (Example 
 on Instagram for our company work)



Edit short-form social content (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) from games, practices, behind-the-scenes and team events

Cut hype videos, highlight packages, player features and recap reels

Sync edits to music, add motion text and graphics, color correct and sound mix

Export in the right formats and aspect ratios for each platform

Organize footage and projects so turnaround stays fast, especially on game days

Take creative direction and feedback from our US team, and bring your own ideas too



What we’re looking for



A portfolio of short-form edits. Sports content is a big plus.

Strong skills in Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut

A feel for pacing, music and energy. You know what makes a reel hit.

Reliability and good communication. Deadlines matter in sports, because content has to go out while the moment is still hot.

REQUIREMENTS

• Experience managing accounts receivable, overdue balances, accounts payable, and payment calendars.

• Experience organizing year-end records and working with a CPA or external accountant.

title: Real Estate Appointment Setter – Warm Leads Only (Room to Grow)
description:
JOB TITLE

Remote Phone Rep, Land Seller Calls (Part-Time, Room to Grow)



TYPE OF WORK: Part-time

WAGE: $5/hour + $300 bonus per deal

HOURS PER WEEK: 20 to start



JOB OVERVIEW



Ridgeline Land Solutions buys vacant land directly from owners all over the United States, and we're growing. We're looking for someone to grow with us.



This role starts at 4 hours a day, but it is not meant to stay that way. As you prove yourself on the phone, you'll be offered more hours and more responsibility, including taking on more of the deal process. We would much rather grow someone from inside the team than keep hiring new people. If you want a long-term role with a small business where your work is noticed and rewarded, this is it.



Our texting team finds landowners who say they're open to selling. You call them, learn about the land and why they might sell, and book them for an offer call with our team. You'll be the first real voice a seller hears from us, so how you sound on the phone matters more than anything else. You don't need years of sales experience. We will train you. We need someone who speaks clear English, shows up every day, and is easy to coach.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Call warm leads fast. When a landowner says yes to selling over text, you get them on the phone right away while they're still interested, then keep working down a ranked daily call list

- Follow a proven call script: confirm the property, ask about access, ownership and timeline, and find out why they might sell

- Get the seller's asking price, timeline and reason for selling on every call

- Book an offer call on our calendar before you hang up

- Follow a set callback schedule for sellers who don't answer: voi
, a text, and a call again on set days

- Log every call in our CRM and post a short call summary in Slack



At the start, you won't make offers or talk numbers. Our team handles every price conversation. Your job is to learn about the land and the seller and get the offer call booked.



SCHEDULE, PAY AND GROWTH



- Starting hours: 9:00 am to 1:00 pm US Eastern, Monday to Friday (20 hours a week)

- Base pay: $5 per hour

- Deal bonus: $300 for every property we buy from a seller you spoke with on the first call (paid once the land is in our name, for deals that go under contract within 90 days of your call)

- Paid weekly, every Friday

- Independent contractor, fully remote



Room to grow: the bonus means your income goes up as you get better at your job, and strong performers will be offered more hours and a bigger role in the business over time. We want this to be a long-term position for the right person.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Required:

- Excellent spoken English with a clear, easy-to-understand accent. Many of our sellers are older, rural Americans, so they need to understand you easily on the phone

- Reliable. You show up on time every shift and communicate if something comes up

- Coachable. You take feedback on your calls and improve quickly

- Friendly and confident asking direct questions about price, timeline and reasons for selling

- Able to listen, let people talk, and politely steer back to the questions

- A quiet place to work, a good headset and reliable internet

- Available 9:00 am to 1:00 pm US Eastern every weekday

- Looking for a long-term role, not a short side gig



Nice to have:

- Outbound calling, appointment setting or sales experience

- Experience with real estate or land sellers

- Experience with GoHighLevel, Slack or a similar CRM

- Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude

- You've worked with US clients before



HOW TO APPLY



We only review applications that include a voice recording. Start your application with the words "gravel road" so we know you read this far.



Send:

1. Your resume or a short summary of your work experience

2. A link to a 1 minute voice recording introducing yourself. Just talk to us naturally, no script. Tell us who you are and about any work you've done on the phone or with customers. Record it on Vocaroo or upload it to Google Drive, and make sure anyone with the link can listen.

3. Confirm you can work 9:00 am to 1:00 pm US Eastern, Monday to Friday, starting next week.



We'll invite the strongest applicants to book a short live interview. If you're looking for a long-term role where you can grow, we'd love to hear from you.
